paper.title: The Working Set of a Coding Agent: Coherence Debt in Repository-Scale Tasks
paper.abstract: Repository-scale coding requires an agent to keep tests, imports, configuration, and migration rules consistent within a bounded context window. We model this as reconstructing a coupled-fact graph: at each edit, a required fact comes from recent context or parametric memory, and the facts covered by neither form coherence debt. We supply and withhold each channel and inject faults across seven models and five harnesses. As expected, no model completes a task on an unseen API with both channels

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 repository-scale coding agent 的一个很具体也很关键的问题：模型在做跨文件修改时，真正决定成败的不是“上下文长不长”或“会不会分解任务”，而是编辑当下所需的耦合事实是否可用。作者把这些事实的可用来源分成两条通道：最近上下文中的 read-derived facts，以及模型参数里已经记住的 parametric memory。若某个必要事实两条通道都覆盖不到，就形成 coherence debt，模型会在不完整世界模型下继续写代码，导致局部看似合理、全局却不一致的补丁。论文要回答的是：这两条通道能否互相替代，缺失事实到底造成多大损失，以及现有基于“读了什么”的诊断方法为什么经常看不清真正的问题。
summary.importance: 对 coding agent 评测和训练都有启发。第一，它把 repository-level coding 失败从笼统的“上下文不够”“检索不准”收缩成一个更可操作的因果对象：edit-time fact availability。这个视角比单纯统计读取轨迹更接近真正的错误来源。第二，它说明 parametric memory 与显式上下文之间存在强替代关系，因此很多在熟悉仓库或熟悉 API 上看起来有效的 agent 策略，可能只是吃到了模型记忆，而不是工作流设计真的合理。第三，它指出 read-derived instrumentation 有系统性盲点：模型缺事实时不会停下来，而是会猜、会编、会继续行动，所以仅看读取行为会低估短缺、也会误判 harness 设计。对预训练研究者来说，这篇论文虽然不直接讲 pretrain，但它触到一个很重要的接口：模型参数里到底记住了什么、这些记忆如何与外部上下文替代、以及 benchmark 是否在无意中把 parametric prior 当成了 agent 能力。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出一个两通道、编辑时刻的工作集框架。每次编辑都依赖一组 coupled facts，例如某个 rename 需要同步 imports、tests、config、migration rule。事实来源要么是近期上下文，要么是参数记忆。若都没有覆盖，就产生 coherence debt。这个框架的好处是把 repository coherence 从模糊概念变成可干预对象。

实验设计很讲究控制变量。第一组是四个虚构 API migration 任务，每个任务有 12 条可机械校验的 requirement。closed-book 条件下不给 workspace 和 tools，等于把两条通道都尽量清空；matched front-loaded 条件则把精确规则和源码直接放进 prompt，模型和工具面保持不变，用来测试“上下文能否替代记忆”。第二组是真实 Pydantic migration，有 79 个测试；再构造一个 twin 版本，把所有 API 名称重命名，使模型原有记忆失效，用来隔离 parametric memory 的作用。第三组是在 tool-using 轨迹中测量：编辑某个文件前，agent 是否在短时间内读过它依赖的事实。第四组是作者自己构造的 synthetic tasks，因为所需事实完全已知，可以做 fault injection，精确测量缺某个事实会损失哪部分工作。

论文还有两个很有意思的边界分析。其一，availability 不是唯一决定因素：当 written standard 和 working code 冲突时，agent 会系统性偏向书面规范，即使代码才是更好的指导。这说明“事实被看见”不等于“事实被正确加权”。其二，任务分解不是天然有益：若任务耦合紧，拆给 subagents 反而会把相互依赖的事实切断，造成额外 coherence debt。作者还比较了不同 harness 的 token 成本，发现达到同样测试通过率时，系统开销可差到 12.8 倍，但前台持有上下文只差 1.8 倍，说明很多昂贵设计并没有换来更好的事实覆盖。
summary.experiments:
最关键的结果有五个。第一，在四个虚构 migration 上，154 次 closed-book 试验里没有任何模型能完成任务；而把同样事实前置到 prompt 后，300 次匹配试验里有 299 次至少满足 12 条要求中的 9 条。这几乎是直接证明：上下文中的事实可以替代缺失的参数记忆。第二，在真实 Pydantic migration 的重命名版本上，7 个模型里有 66/70 次试验停在同一个分数，并且通过的是完全相同的 24/79 个测试，说明当记忆失效后，失败位置高度一致，决定因素是事实可用性而不是模型风格差异。第三，作者声称损害与缺失事实支持的工作量呈线性关系：拿走哪个事实，就精确损失它支撑的那部分修改，不会无端扩散到别处。第四，距离本身不是问题：只要事实被提供，即便放在 128,000 字符上下文的远端，模型使用它的可靠性也接近放在编辑点附近。第五，不同 harness 在全部通过测试的配置下，token 消耗相差 12.8×，但并未在事实被 withholding 时恢复额外能力，说明很多系统成本只是为同样结果付更高价。

还有两个负结果同样重要。其一，在 39 次冲突试验中，agent 一律跟随书面标准而非现有正确代码，说明覆盖不等于判别。其二，这套框架在 SWE-bench 上不再直接成立，因为模型可能已经记住仓库，且任务结构观测过粗，导致“读了什么”不再预测成功与否。作者没有把自己的诊断硬推广到所有真实仓库，这一点比较克制。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先抓三部分。第一是 Introduction 和实验设计，弄清楚 coupled-fact graph、two-channel availability、coherence debt 这三个概念，否则后面结果会显得零散。第二是 closed-book / front-loaded / renamed migration 这三组干预实验，它们是全文最有说服力的因果证据。第三是关于 harness cost、subagent decomposition 和 conflicting facts 的分析，这些部分决定这篇论文不只是一个 coding benchmark 观察，而是在讨论 agent 系统设计的代价与边界。

如果时间有限，优先看主实验图表和作者总结的五个 claim，大约 35 分钟能抓住核心。若要深读，建议重点看 synthetic task 与 fault injection 的构造方式，以及作者为什么说 read-derived instruments 无法测到它们想测的 shortfall。这部分对设计更可靠的 coding-agent 诊断工具很有帮助。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a precise failure mode in repository-scale coding agents: when an agent edits code across files, success is determined less by raw context length or decomposition and more by whether the coupled facts required at edit time are actually available. The authors model fact availability through two channels: recent context obtained by reading or prompt supply, and parametric memory already stored in the model. If a required fact is covered by neither channel, the agent incurs coherence debt and writes from an incomplete view of the repository, producing patches that may look locally plausible but are globally inconsistent. The central question is how these two channels substitute for each other, how much damage missing facts cause, and why read-based diagnostics often fail to reveal the real bottleneck.
summary_en.importance: This is useful for both coding-agent evaluation and training. First, it reframes repository-level failure from vague claims about insufficient context or weak retrieval into a more causal object: edit-time fact availability. That is a sharper target for diagnosis. Second, it shows strong substitution between parametric memory and explicit context, which means many apparently successful agent strategies on familiar repositories or APIs may simply be benefiting from memorized knowledge rather than sound workflow design. Third, it exposes a systematic blind spot in read-derived instrumentation: when facts are missing, agents usually do not stop; they guess, fabricate, and continue. As a result, measuring what the agent read can underestimate the shortfall and mislead harness design. For pretraining researchers, the paper matters because it touches the interface between what is stored in parameters, what must be supplied externally, and how benchmarks can accidentally conflate memorized priors with genuine agent competence.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core framework is a two-channel, edit-time working-set model for repository coherence. Each edit depends on a set of coupled facts, such as imports, tests, configuration rules, migration constraints, or naming conventions. Those facts can come either from recent context or from parametric memory. If neither channel covers a required fact, the edit carries coherence debt. This turns repository coherence from a loose intuition into something that can be manipulated experimentally.

The experimental design is unusually controlled. The first setup uses four fictional API migration tasks, each with 12 mechanically checkable requirements. In the closed-book condition, the model gets the task description but no workspace and no tools, effectively emptying both channels. In the matched front-loaded condition, the exact rules and source files are placed in the prompt while keeping the model and tool surface fixed, isolating whether explicit context can substitute for missing memory. The second setup uses a real Pydantic migration with 79 tests, plus a renamed twin where all API names are changed so that memorized library knowledge becomes useless. This isolates the role of parametric memory. The third setup instruments tool-using trajectories by checking whether the agent read the dependencies of an edited file shortly before editing. The fourth uses synthetic tasks authored by the researchers, where the required facts are fully known, enabling precise fault injection and attribution.

Two boundary findings are especially important. Availability is not sufficient on its own: when written standards conflict with working code, agents systematically follow the written standard even when the code is the better guide. So seeing a fact is not the same as weighting it correctly. Also, decomposition is not automatically helpful: if the task is tightly coupled, splitting it across subagents can sever dependencies and create additional coherence debt. The paper also compares harnesses and finds that some configurations spend far more tokens for the same end result, without improving fact coverage.
summary_en.experiments:
There are five main empirical results. First, on the four fictional migrations, none of the 154 closed-book trials succeeds, while front-loading the exact facts into the prompt lifts 299 of 300 matched trials to at least 9 out of 12 requirements. This is strong evidence that explicit context can substitute for missing parametric knowledge. Second, on the renamed version of the real Pydantic migration, 66 of 70 trials across seven models end at the same score and pass the exact same 24 of 79 tests. Once memorized knowledge is neutralized, failures become highly aligned, suggesting that availability rather than model style determines the outcome. Third, the damage from withholding facts is reported to be linear in the work those facts support: removing a fact costs exactly the edits it enables and no more. Fourth, distance itself is not the issue: when a fact is supplied, models use it about as reliably at the far end of a 128,000-character context as when it is placed near the edit. Fifth, harnesses can differ by 12.8x in total token consumption while holding only 1.8x different amounts of context in front of the model at any moment, and the more expensive setups recover no extra capability when facts are withheld.

Two negative results matter as much. In 39 conflict trials, agents consistently follow written standards over contradictory but working code, showing that coverage does not guarantee correct arbitration. And the framework does not transfer cleanly to SWE-bench, where models likely already know the repositories and the task structure is observed only coarsely, so reading behavior no longer predicts success. The paper is careful not to overclaim universality beyond its controlled workloads.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and experimental design carefully to internalize the three key concepts: coupled-fact graph, two-channel availability, and coherence debt. Without them, the results can look like a collection of coding-agent anecdotes. Second, prioritize the closed-book, front-loaded, and renamed-migration interventions. These are the strongest causal pieces of evidence in the paper. Third, read the sections on harness cost, subagent decomposition, and conflicting facts, because they show that the paper is really about the design limits of coding-agent systems, not just benchmark behavior.

If time is limited, the main figures and the five headline claims are enough to capture the argument in about 35 minutes. For a deeper read, spend time on the synthetic-task construction and the fault-injection analysis, especially the argument that read-derived instruments cannot measure the shortfall they are intended to detect. That part is useful if you care about building better diagnostics for repository-scale agents.

recommendation.zh: 这篇的价值在于把“代码 Agent 不会做”拆成“事实拿不到”；先看 rename 故障和 distance 无关那组结果，它会直接影响你对 parametric memory 与 context engineering 的判断。
recommendation.en: The useful move here is separating 'can't reason' from 'can't access the needed fact'; read the rename failure and distance-invariant results first—they sharpen how you think about parametric memory vs. context.

paper.title: OrchestraBench: Evaluating Multi-Agent Orchestration Failure Modes, Recovery, and Decomposition Quality
paper.abstract: Multi-agent orchestration frameworks are moving from demos to production, yet benchmarks typically report task accuracy without diagnosing why a pipeline failed, where a cascade began, or which routing decision caused the breakdown. OrchestraBench evaluates failure, recovery, and decomposition through a controlled, seed-reproducible failure-injection harness over templated enterprise workflows. It introduces cascade radius and per-failure-mode recovery as primary metrics and compares routing pol

summary.core_problem: 多agent编排基准只报告任务准确率，无法诊断失败原因、级联起点或具体路由决策的问题。
summary.importance: 首个通过可控故障注入系统评估多agent编排的失败模式、恢复能力和分解质量的基准，引入级联半径和单故障模式恢复率等新指标。
summary.technical_approach: 基于模板化企业工作流的种子可复现故障注入harness，使用bootstrap置信区间和配对检验比较路由策略。
summary.experiments: 在26个金标诊断案例上，关键词/flag路由器在有误导或缺失表面flag的对抗案例上得0分，意图推理模型路由器得100%匹配oracle；真实Claude agent在算术依赖链上揭示三级故障处理层次。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-agent orchestration benchmarks report only task accuracy without diagnosing why a pipeline failed, where a cascade began, or which routing decision caused the breakdown.
summary_en.importance: First benchmark to evaluate failure, recovery, and decomposition in multi-agent orchestration via controlled, seed-reproducible failure injection, introducing cascade radius and per-failure-mode recovery as primary metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: A controlled failure-injection harness over templated enterprise workflows, comparing routing policies with bootstrap confidence intervals and paired statistical tests.
summary_en.experiments: On a 26-case gold diagnostic, keyword/flag routers scored 0% on adversarial cases with misleading/missing surface flags, while an intent-reasoning model router scored 100% matching the oracle; probes with a real Claude agent revealed three failure-handling tiers across five MAST modes.

recommendation.zh: 多agent编排的故障注入评测框架，关键词路由在对抗场景下完全失效这一点值得注意，但对预训练研究员主要是了解agent能力边界。
recommendation.en: Failure-injection benchmark for multi-agent orchestration; the 0% vs 100% gap between keyword and reasoning routers is notable, mainly useful for understanding agent capability boundaries.

paper.title: Relevant but Incomplete: Referential Dangling as a Paradigm-Level Failure Mode in Hard Prompt Compression
paper.abstract: Hard prompt compression reduces long-context inference cost by independently scoring tokens, sentences, or chunks and retaining the highest-scoring units under a budget. We identify a structural failure in this procedure: independent selection can split dependent evidence pairs, retaining one member while deleting the other. summary.core_problem: 这篇工作指出硬提示压缩中的一个结构性失效：压缩器独立选择高相关 token、句子或段落时，可能保留答案片段，却删除解释该片段所需的前置实体定义或桥接证据。作者称这种现象为 referential dangling。
summary.importance: 这项结果对长上下文推理和推理侧降本有直接启发。很多 prompt compression 方法优化的是局部相关性或重要性分数，但多跳问答需要的是完整证据链。保留“看起来相关”的片段并不等于保留“可推理”的上下文。对基座研究来说，它提醒长上下文能力评估不能只看召回率或压缩后 token 数，也要检查证据依赖是否闭合。对 serving 和压缩系统来说，它说明压缩目标需要从独立片段打分走向依赖感知选择。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先形式化 extractive hard compressor：给定上下文、问题和 token 预算，压缩器输出源文本片段的子序列。referential dangling 被定义为：压缩结果保留了任务相关句子，但删除了使该句子可解释、可用于回答问题的支持片段。例如保留答案实体和一个地理事实，却删除了把问题主体连接到该地理事实的桥接句。实验先诊断 Beaver 这类基于 embedding 相似度和 chunk 排序的压缩器，再扩展到多种压缩方法。随后做两类修复：一类是 annotation-guided reselection，把遗漏的支持段落插回，并用删除最低分非支持段落抵消预算；另一类是自动 restoration，从被删除文本中生成候选句，训练小型分类器判断这些句子是否是解释已保留文本所需的依赖，再插回高分候选。
summary.experiments: 在 compression ratio 0.30 下，Beaver 在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA 和 MuSiQue 的 bridge examples 上造成 34% 到 54% 的答案路径不完整。人工审计显示 dangling 诊断 precision 为 95%。在共享 HotpotQA bridge 集合上，6 个压缩器都出现该问题，比例为 32% 到 60%。LongBench-v2 Single-Document QA 的 80 个文档全部包含至少一个 dangling reference。修复实验使用 Qwen3-8B 作为下游答题模型：在 dangling examples 上，插回遗漏支持段落并保持预算不变，准确率提升 29 到 34 个百分点，p < 1e-4，并恢复原压缩上下文与完整支持上下文之间至少 88% 的准确率差距。自动 restoration 在 HotpotQA 上将准确率提升 4.7 个百分点，压缩率仅从 0.30 变为 0.31。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中的 Figure 1 和问题定义，理解为什么答案字符串存在仍然可能不可用。然后看 Problem Formulation 中 Sufficiency 的定义，它是这篇工作的核心抽象。实验部分重点看三组数字：Beaver 在三套多跳 QA 上的 dangling 率、6 个压缩器的横向结果、annotation-guided reselection 的准确率恢复幅度。自动 restoration 部分可以快速看方法框架和 HotpotQA 结果，主要价值在于证明依赖修复可以部分自动化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper identifies a structural failure mode in hard prompt compression. Independent token, sentence, or chunk selection can keep a relevant fragment while removing the antecedent, entity definition, or bridge fact needed to interpret it. The authors call this failure referential dangling.
summary_en.importance: The result matters for long-context inference and cost reduction. Many compressors optimize local relevance, perplexity, embedding similarity, attention-derived importance, or learned salience. Multi-hop reasoning instead requires a closed evidence path. A compressed prompt can contain the answer string and still be unusable because the dependency that links the query to that answer has been removed. This is a useful diagnostic for pretraining and inference research around long context: recall of relevant spans is not enough; dependency completeness should be measured.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work formalizes extractive hard compression as selecting a source-ordered subset of the input under a token budget. A dangling case occurs when a task-relevant retained sentence lacks sufficient retained support to be interpreted and used in the evidence chain for the query. The empirical study starts with Beaver, a chunk-ranking compressor using Qwen3-0.6B embeddings, and then checks whether the issue generalizes to other compressors. Two repair strategies are studied. The first is annotation-guided reselection: reinsert the omitted supporting paragraph and remove the lowest-scoring non-supporting paragraphs to keep the token budget fixed. The second is automatic restoration: generate candidate sentences from omitted text and train a compact classifier to rank whether a candidate is needed to interpret retained content, then reinsert top-ranked candidates without using support annotations at inference time.
summary_en.experiments: At a 0.30 compression ratio, Beaver leaves answer paths incomplete in 34% to 54% of bridge examples across HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue. A human audit reports 95% precision for the dangling diagnosis. The issue is not specific to Beaver: on a shared HotpotQA bridge set, all six tested compressors show dangling rates between 32% and 60%. In LongBench-v2 Single-Document QA, all 80 documents contain at least one dangling reference. With Qwen3-8B as the downstream answer model, annotation-guided reselection improves accuracy by 29 to 34 points on dangling examples at the same token budget, with p < 1e-4, and recovers at least 88% of the gap between the original compressed context and a context retaining both annotated supporting paragraphs. The automatic restoration method improves HotpotQA accuracy by 4.7 points while changing the compression ratio only from 0.30 to 0.31.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Start with the motivating example and the formal definition of sufficiency, since that is the main conceptual contribution. Then read the diagnostic results for Beaver and the six-compressor comparison. The most informative ablation is the fixed-budget reselection experiment, because it separates missing dependency structure from mere token-budget shortage. The automatic restoration section is useful as a first step toward dependency-aware compression, but the larger lesson is the evaluation failure of independent relevance scoring.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它把“压缩掉信息”细化成“压缩断了依赖对”；如果你在做 long-context pruning，只看 dangling 定义、干预实验和错误率表就够，足以改内部设计。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it sharpens “compression loses information” into “compression breaks dependency pairs”; if you work on long-context pruning, the dangling definition plus the intervention tables are enough to change your design instincts.

paper.title: When Absence Is Evidence: Evaluating Completeness-Sensitive Negative Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often asked whether something is absent from a record, list, or retrieved context. Yet non-observation licenses a negative answer only when evidence completely covers the query scope; otherwise, the answer should remain unknown. We call this completeness-sensitive negative reasoning. summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 在“缺失是否能作为否定证据”这类 completeness-sensitive negative reasoning 场景中的判断能力：只有证据覆盖查询范围时，未观察到某项才应推出否定，否则应回答未知。
summary.importance: 这是一篇评测协议与失效模式分析工作，不是在做新模型。它把常见 QA/RAG 场景里一个经常被混淆的推理类型单独拆出来，并区分了 justified negative 与 insufficient evidence，对检索增强、长上下文问答和 verifier 设计都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CROWN-QA，包括受控合成集 CROWN-Synth 和真实文档对比集 CROWN-Real。核心设计是固定问题和已观察事实，只改变与查询相关的 coverage，从而隔离“证据是否完整”这一变量，测模型是否会把隐式不完整证据误判为可闭包的否定结论。作者还分析了 prompting 如何在 over-closure 与 under-closure 之间重新分配错误。
summary.experiments: 在三个 LLM family 上测试，结论是 closure judgment 不稳定，且存在明显 over-closure：模型常不能稳定区分 Certified-Negative 与 Unknown。CROWN-Synth 中最主要的失败模式是不对称的：模型往往能识别隐式完整证据，却把隐式部分证据也当成 query-covering。摘要未给出具体模型规模和提升数字，这更像 failure analysis 而非 leaderboard 论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自韩国与美国高校合作团队，包括 Sangmyung University、CUNY、Hansung University、Sookmyung Women’s University、Yonsei University；未见一线大模型实验室背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs can reason correctly in completeness-sensitive negative reasoning: absence supports a negative answer only when the available evidence fully covers the query scope; otherwise the answer should be unknown.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and failure-analysis paper rather than a new modeling method. It isolates a subtle but common reasoning pattern in QA and RAG, separating justified negatives from insufficient-evidence cases, which matters for retrieval-based systems, long-context QA, and verifier design.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces CROWN-QA, with CROWN-Synth as a controlled paired benchmark and CROWN-Real as a real-document contrast set. The key design keeps the question and observed facts fixed while varying only query-relative coverage, so the benchmark can specifically test whether models mistake partial evidence for complete evidence. The paper also studies how prompting shifts errors between over-closure and under-closure.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is tested across three LLM families. The main finding is unstable closure judgment with substantial over-closure: models often fail to distinguish Certified-Negative from Unknown. On CROWN-Synth, the dominant failure is asymmetric: models can often recognize implicitly complete evidence, but still treat implicitly partial evidence as query-covering. The abstract does not provide model sizes or detailed numeric tables, consistent with a diagnostic benchmark paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from a collaboration across Korean and US universities, including Sangmyung University, CUNY, Hansung University, Sookmyung Women’s University, and Yonsei University; no major frontier-lab affiliation is evident.

recommendation.zh: 这是个干净的 failure mode benchmark，不改 pretrain prior，但做 RAG、long-context 或 verifier 的人应记下“partial evidence 被误当 complete”这个坑；看任务构造和错误分解就够了。
recommendation.en: A clean failure-mode benchmark: it does not change pretraining priors, but anyone building RAG, long-context QA, or verifiers should note the systematic confusion between partial and complete evidence; the task design and error breakdown are the parts worth reading.

paper.title: Stuck on "A": Diagnosing and Repairing Interface Injury in Attention-to-KDA Linearization of a 0.6B Language Model
paper.abstract: We convert 21 of 28 full-attention layers of Qwen3-0.6B-Base into KDA (Kimi Delta Attention) linear-attention layers on a single consumer-grade GPU budget, and ask a simple question: what exactly does the conversion break? After surgery, hidden-state alignment and end-to-end KL distillation drive the student close to its teacher in perplexity, yet multiple-choice accuracy stays near random chance (25-29% vs. the teacher's 50.6% on C-Eval). Using a four-permutation diagnostic that rotates answer

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的不是“线性化能不能把困惑度做回来”，而是“把全注意力 LLM 改造成 KDA 线性注意力后，究竟坏在什么地方”。作者把 Qwen3-0.6B-Base 的 28 层里 21 层替换成 KDA，发现即便通过逐层 hidden-state 对齐和端到端 KL 蒸馏，语言建模损失已经接近教师，多项选择能力却仍接近随机。全文给出的核心诊断是：模型未必丢了全部知识，而是损伤了把内部知识映射到选项接口上的能力，也就是论文所说的 interface injury。这个问题比一般的“能力退化”更细，因为标准 CE / PPL / KL 指标几乎看不出来。
summary.importance: 对预训练和模型改造研究的意义主要有三点。第一，它给出一个很具体的反例：低 perplexity gap 不等于任务能力保留，尤其不等于离散决策接口仍然正常。这对架构替换、蒸馏、压缩、量化后再训练都很重要。第二，它把“知识丢失”和“接口损伤”区分开来，提出了可操作的诊断方法，而不是停留在现象描述。第三，它展示了一个预算很紧的 conversion recipe，并把失败细节公开出来，包括错误的 teacher init、gate 初始化、bf16 更新吞噬、cache bug 等。这类负结果和排障记录，对做架构 surgery 的人比单纯报一个最终分数更有用。量级上，这不是提出新预训练范式的工作，但它对‘如何评估和修复架构改造后的能力错位’有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三段。第一段是架构转换。作者从 Qwen3-0.6B-Base 出发，保留每 4 层中的 1 层原生 GQA，共保留 7 层，其余 21 层替换为 KDA。KDA 配置包括 16 heads、head dim 128、短卷积 k=4、q/k L2 norm、低秩 forget gate、beta write gate、gated RMSNorm、NoPE。这样做不是纯线性模型，而是混合结构：75% 层用 O(1) recurrent state，剩余层仍保留线性增长 KV cache。作者还详细分析了 forget gate 初始化，指出几乎不遗忘会让 recurrent state 爆炸，遗忘过强又会比随机还差，最终采用 g6 初始化，forget half-life 中位数约 6.3 tokens。

第二段是两级蒸馏。先做 layer-wise hidden alignment：每个 KDA 层对齐对应 teacher hidden state，teacher 冻结，误差跨层 detach，只训练 KDA 参数 193.6M，学习率 1e-4 到 1e-5，batch 为 8192 tokens/step。这个阶段把 CE 从 9.48 拉到 4.125，但 C-Eval 仍只有 25.5%。随后做 end-to-end forward KL distillation，在预训练文本上最小化 teacher-student next-token 分布的 forward KL，不混 CE；训练范围扩大到 KDA + 全部 MLP + LayerNorm，共 457.9M 参数，embedding、lm_head 和保留的 7 个 attention 层冻结。为适配单卡显存，作者实现了 chunked fp32 KL，避免物化全量 logits。7000 steps、总计 57.3M tokens 后，valid CE 到 2.9385，teacher 为 2.8108，gap 仅 +0.128 nats，valid KL 0.160，但 C-Eval 只有 28.8%。

第三段是诊断与修复。诊断上，作者构造了 161 道来自训练语料、与 benchmark 零重叠的四选一题，每题做四次 cyclic option rotation，内容不变，只旋转 A/B/C/D 标签。若模型跟随内容，正确标签应随 rotation 改变；若只是知识丢失，预测应更接近均匀随机。实际结果是学生模型 81.06% 时间选 A，161 题中有 106 题在四次 rotation 下都保持同一标签，且正确选项平均 margin 为 -0.117 nats。这说明它不是单纯不会，而是输出接口塌缩到了标签偏置。修复上，作者加入一个 1000-step 的 Stage 3b，用 completion-only KL 在 teacher 验证过的 MCQ permutations、诗歌、翻译 QA 上做格式修复。这个阶段不追求全面分布拟合，而是专门修补“问题-选项-答案”接口。之后再做 persona alignment，包括 SFT、identity booster 和一轮 on-policy DPO，并用 15 个 benchmark guard points 监控遗忘。
summary.experiments:
最关键的结果有四组。第一，转换初始状态下，采用最终选定的 g6 gate 初始化时，held-out ruler CE 为 9.48；teacher 为 3.01，说明直接 surgery 损伤很大。作者还比较了极端遗忘和极端保留，前者性能比随机还差，后者 recurrent state 不稳定。第二，逐层 hidden alignment 把 overall CE 从 9.48 降到 4.13 左右，但 C-Eval 仍在 25% 随机线附近，证明 hidden trajectory 对齐不足以恢复决策能力。第三，端到端 KL 蒸馏 7000 steps、57.3M tokens 后，valid CE 2.9385 对 teacher 2.8108，gap +0.128；valid KL 0.160；但 C-Eval 仅 28.8%，依然远低于 teacher 的 50.6%。这是全文最有信息量的数字：LM loss 几乎追平，任务能力却没有回来。第四，格式修复阶段后，C-Eval 从 28.8% 提升到 41.3%，最终 persona 对齐后到 41.83%；label stickiness 约减半，correct-option margin 由负转正，但 valid KL 从 0.160 变差到 0.196，说明接口修复和通用分布拟合之间存在可测的 trade-off。

一些消融也值得看。作者追查了两代失败的 projection transplant：v1 实际没有成功 transplant，和 teacher cosine 约为 0、和随机初始化 cosine 约 0.69；v2 虽然做了 transplant，但功能上与 teacher 近乎正交，mean cosine 仅 0.007。v3 放弃 projection transplant，functional probe cosine 反而升到 0.434。这个结果说明在 attention→KDA 这种异构替换里，参数形状可对齐不代表功能可迁移。另一个工程细节是 bf16 update swallowing 和 cache bug，这些问题如果不排掉，很容易把“架构不行”和“实现有错”混在一起。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议先抓三处。第一看引言和 Figure 1 附近，理解作者为什么说 perplexity 会“撒谎”，以及 interface injury 与普通知识遗忘的区别。第二看四-permutation diagnostic 的定义和结果表，这是全文最值得带走的方法资产；如果只记一个点，就记这个。第三看 conversion pipeline 里关于 gate 初始化、projection transplant 取舍、chunked KL 实现的部分，这些是做架构改造时真正会踩到的坑。

如果时间有限，优先顺序可以是：Introduction → 四-permutation 诊断结果 → Stage 3b repair → failure audit。预计 25 到 35 分钟能抓住主要信息。若准备复现或做类似 linearization，建议细看附录里的实现审计、数值误差验证、训练超参和 bug 记录，因为这篇工作的价值有一半在这些“为什么前两版失败”的细节里。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than whether linearization preserves perplexity: after replacing most full-attention layers with KDA linear attention, what exactly breaks? Starting from Qwen3-0.6B-Base, the authors convert 21 of 28 layers to KDA and show that hidden-state alignment plus end-to-end KL distillation can recover language-modeling loss surprisingly well, yet multiple-choice accuracy remains near random. Their central claim, supported by targeted diagnostics, is that the model may retain part of the underlying knowledge while losing the interface that maps that knowledge onto answer-option labels. This “interface injury” is largely invisible to standard CE/PPL/KL metrics.
summary_en.importance: The main value is methodological rather than scale-driven. First, it provides a concrete failure case where a small perplexity gap does not imply preserved task ability, which matters for architecture conversion, distillation, compression, and post-hoc model surgery more broadly. Second, it separates knowledge loss from interface corruption with an operational diagnostic instead of a vague qualitative story. Third, it documents a budget-constrained conversion pipeline together with failure forensics: broken teacher initialization, gate-init pathologies, bf16 update swallowing, and cache bugs. For researchers working on pretraining-adjacent architecture changes, these negative results and debugging notes are more useful than a single final score.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three stages. Stage 1 is architecture conversion. From Qwen3-0.6B-Base, every fourth layer remains native GQA, leaving 7 full-attention layers and replacing the other 21 with KDA. The KDA stack uses 16 heads, head dimension 128, causal short convolution with k=4, L2-normalized q/k, low-rank forget gates, beta write gates, gated RMSNorm, and NoPE. This yields a hybrid model rather than a pure linear-attention model: 75% of layers use O(1) recurrent state, while the retained GQA layers still have linearly growing KV cache. A notable engineering point is gate initialization. The paper shows that near-total retention destabilizes the recurrent state, while excessive forgetting performs worse than random; their adopted g6 initialization gives a median forget half-life of about 6.3 tokens.

Stage 2 is two-step distillation. The first step is layer-wise hidden-state alignment: each KDA layer is trained against the corresponding teacher hidden state, with the teacher frozen and errors detached across layers. Only KDA parameters are updated in this phase, 193.6M trainable parameters total, at 8,192 tokens per step. This reduces CE from 9.48 to about 4.13, but C-Eval stays at chance. The second step is end-to-end forward-KL distillation on pretraining text. The objective is pure forward KL between teacher and student next-token distributions, without mixing in CE. Trainable parameters now include KDA, all MLPs, and all LayerNorms, 457.9M in total, while embeddings, tied lm_head, and the 7 retained attention layers remain frozen. To fit a single 32GB GPU budget, they implement chunked fp32 KL instead of materializing full logits. After 7,000 steps over 57.3M tokens, validation CE reaches 2.9385 versus the teacher’s 2.8108, a gap of only +0.128 nats, with validation KL 0.160, yet C-Eval is still only 28.8%.

Stage 3 is diagnosis and repair. The diagnostic is a four-permutation multiple-choice test: 161 clean four-option questions are constructed from the training corpus with zero benchmark overlap, and each question is evaluated under four cyclic rotations of option labels. A content-following model should track the correct option as labels rotate; a model that simply forgot should fail roughly uniformly. Instead, the converted model predicts “A” 81.06% of the time, and 106 of 161 questions keep the same predicted label under all four rotations. The average margin on the correct option is negative, -0.117 nats. This points to label-interface collapse rather than uniform forgetting. The repair stage then runs 1,000 steps of completion-only KL on teacher-verified MCQ permutations, poetry, and translation QA, explicitly targeting the question-option-answer interface. Persona alignment is added afterward via SFT, an identity booster, and one round of on-policy DPO, monitored with 15 benchmark guard points.
summary_en.experiments:
Four results matter most. First, immediately after conversion, the adopted g6 gate initialization gives held-out CE 9.48, versus 3.01 for the teacher, showing that naive surgery is highly lossy. The paper also compares extreme forgetting and extreme retention, showing that one collapses performance below random while the other destabilizes the recurrent state. Second, layer-wise hidden alignment reduces CE from 9.48 to roughly 4.13, but C-Eval remains around the 25% random baseline, demonstrating that hidden-trajectory matching is insufficient for restoring decision behavior. Third, end-to-end KL distillation over 7,000 steps and 57.3M tokens yields validation CE 2.9385 versus teacher 2.8108, only +0.128 nats apart, with validation KL 0.160, yet C-Eval reaches only 28.8% compared with the teacher’s 50.6%. This is the key empirical point: LM loss nearly recovers, but task ability does not. Fourth, the format-repair stage lifts C-Eval from 28.8% to 41.3%, and the final persona-aligned model reaches 41.83%. Label stickiness is roughly halved, and the correct-option margin turns positive, but validation KL worsens from 0.160 to 0.196, indicating a measurable trade-off between interface repair and general distribution matching.

The ablations are also informative. Two generations of projection transplant fail for different reasons: v1 did not actually transplant meaningful teacher projections at all, with cosine near 0 to the teacher and about 0.69 to random init; v2 performed a transplant that was functionally almost orthogonal to the teacher, with mean cosine only 0.007. In v3, abandoning projection transplant improves functional probe cosine to 0.434. This suggests that in heterogeneous replacements such as attention-to-KDA, parameter-shape compatibility does not imply functional transfer. The implementation notes on bf16 update swallowing and cache bugs are also useful because they isolate architecture failure from plain engineering mistakes.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the early diagnostic framing to understand why perplexity can be misleading here and how interface injury differs from ordinary knowledge loss. Second, read the four-permutation diagnostic and its result tables carefully; this is the most reusable idea in the paper. Third, inspect the conversion pipeline sections on gate initialization, projection-transplant failure, and chunked KL implementation, since these are the parts most likely to matter in real architecture surgery.

A practical reading order is: Introduction → four-permutation diagnostic → Stage 3b repair → failure audit. That should take about 25–35 minutes for a solid skim. If you plan to reproduce or extend this kind of linearization, spend extra time on the appendices covering implementation audits, numerical checks, hyperparameters, and bug records. Much of the paper’s value lies in why earlier versions failed, not just in the final recipe.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是看 KDA，而是看 failure analysis：PPL/KL 好看不代表接口没坏，做架构替换或蒸馏时应立刻加这种 option-rotation 诊断。
recommendation.en: Read this for the failure analysis, not for KDA: good PPL/KL does not mean the interface survived, and option-rotation diagnostics should be added immediately to any architecture-surgery or distillation pipeline.

paper.title: Diagnosing Search Behavior and Failure Modes in Long-Horizon Search Agents
paper.abstract: Deep search agents answer difficult information-seeking questions by iteratively issuing search queries to gather supporting evidence, but it remains unclear whether and how greater search effort leads to better answers. summary.core_problem: 长程搜索智能体通常用最终答案准确率来评价，但轨迹本身是黑箱：更多搜索步数、更长上下文和更多工具调用并不一定对应更好的答案，也无法区分错误是因为没找到证据，还是找到了证据却没有正确使用。
summary.importance: 对训练和改进 deep research / search agent 有直接诊断价值。它把 agent 失败拆成 retrieval gap 和 utilization gap，说明不同能力档位的 agent 需要不同修复方向：弱 agent 主要问题在查询生成和证据召回，强 agent 的瓶颈转向验证和答案归一化。对预训练研究者的启发是，长程能力不能只靠最终指标或搜索预算衡量，轨迹级信号应成为训练和评测的一部分。
summary.technical_approach: 构建轨迹级诊断框架，在 BrowseComp-Plus 上使用人工标注的文档级相关性判断，逐 step 评估 agent 检索到的证据。框架将行为分成两端：检索端看 agent 找到了哪些 gold evidence，利用端看这些证据是否被正确转化为答案。错误被分为 retrieval gap（必要证据从未被检索到）和 utilization gap（相关证据已在上下文中但答案仍错）。分析还覆盖搜索量、上下文消耗、cumulative gold-evidence recall、episode 级证据到达时间、重复查询和查询策略。六个 agent 在统一 ReAct 框架、工具和检索器下比较，包括 mid-scale 的 Tongyi DeepResearch、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B、gpt-oss-120b，以及 frontier-scale 的 Kimi K2.6、GLM 5.1、DeepSeek V4 Pro，并在 BrowseComp open-web 设置上验证主要结论。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有五点。第一，搜索步数和上下文花费不预测准确率，较准的 agent 往往也更便宜。第二，cumulative gold-evidence recall 与最终准确率强相关：同一问题上，找到关键证据的 agent 通常答对，没找到的几乎答错。第三，错误可稳定分成 retrieval gap 和 utilization gap；准确率相近的 agent 可能位于这一划分的两端，因此修复方式不能只看 leaderboard。第四，证据通常在轨迹早期出现，之后大量 episode 不增加新证据；错误轨迹会在没有找到剩余证据的情况下继续搜索，形成 wasted tail。第五，强 agent 的特征不是搜得更多，而是查询更干净，冗余重查更少；查询风格本身不是决定因素，关键是查询是否落到证据上。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看五个 findings 的组织逻辑，再重点看 outcome attribution、failure-mode taxonomy 和 trajectory mechanism 三部分。图表上应关注搜索 effort 与准确率的散点关系、gold-evidence recall 与准确率的关系、retrieval/utilization gap 的分解，以及证据到达时间随 episode 的分布。对做 agent 训练或 RL 的人，值得进一步思考如何把 retrieval recall、证据到达效率和 verification 信号做成 reward 或训练目标；对做系统的人，可关注 snippet-stream 管理、低价值页面访问过滤和上下文污染问题。预计阅读时间 30–40 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon search agents are usually evaluated by final answer accuracy, leaving the trajectory opaque: more search steps, larger context, and heavier tool use do not necessarily yield better answers, and final metrics cannot distinguish failures caused by missing evidence from failures caused by misusing evidence that was already retrieved.
summary_en.importance: The work gives a useful trajectory-level diagnosis for training and improving deep research agents. It separates retrieval gaps from utilization gaps and shows that agents at different capability levels need different fixes: weaker agents are limited mainly by query direction and evidence recall, while stronger agents are closer to an oracle-reader ceiling and need better verification and answer normalization. For foundation-model researchers, the main implication is that long-horizon ability should not be measured only by final scores or search budgets; trajectory-level signals should inform both evaluation and training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces a diagnostic framework grounded in human-annotated document-level relevance judgments on BrowseComp-Plus. At each search step, it evaluates what evidence the agent retrieves and how effectively that evidence is used. Errors are decomposed into retrieval gaps, where necessary evidence is never found, and utilization gaps, where relevant evidence is retrieved but the answer remains wrong. The analysis tracks search volume, context spend, cumulative gold-evidence recall, episode-level evidence arrival, repeated queries, and query strategy. Six agents are compared under the same ReAct framework, tools, and retriever: Tongyi DeepResearch, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, and gpt-oss-120b at mid-scale, and Kimi K2.6, GLM 5.1, and DeepSeek V4 Pro at frontier scale. The main conclusions are also validated on BrowseComp with open-web search.
summary_en.experiments: There are five central findings. First, search volume and context spend do not predict accuracy; more accurate agents are often cheaper. Second, cumulative gold-evidence recall tracks accuracy closely: on the same question, agents that retrieve the decisive evidence usually answer correctly, while agents that miss it almost never do. Third, failures split into retrieval gaps and utilization gaps, and agents with similar accuracy can have opposite balances, so fixes should be diagnosis-specific rather than leaderboard-specific. Fourth, evidence usually arrives early, after which many episodes add no new evidence; incorrect trajectories keep searching without recovering missing evidence, producing a wasted tail. Fifth, stronger agents search more cleanly rather than more; redundant re-querying is rare in successful runs and marks failure, while the broad query style matters less than whether queries actually land on evidence.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the five findings and then focus on outcome attribution, failure-mode taxonomy, and trajectory mechanism. The most useful figures are likely the scatter plots of search effort versus accuracy, the relationship between cumulative gold-evidence recall and accuracy, the retrieval/utilization error decomposition, and the episode-level evidence arrival curves. Readers working on agent training or RL can consider how retrieval recall, evidence arrival efficiency, and verification could become rewards or training signals. Readers working on systems can focus on snippet-stream management, gating low-value page opens, and context pollution. Estimated reading time: 30–40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读失败分解和 effort-quality 曲线即可；它给 test-time search scaling 泼冷水，setup 比常见 agent demo 干净。
recommendation.en: Read the failure decomposition and effort-quality curves; it is a cleaner warning against naive test-time search scaling than typical agent demos.
