summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是 memory-based self-improving agent 里的一个失真源：agent 不更新参数，而是把过往 episode 写入外部记忆库，并用一个分数决定哪些记忆会被未来检索和复用。问题在于，部署环境通常没有真实标签，这个分数只能由 LLM 自评或近似 judge 给出。论文指出，这会产生系统性的 reward inflation：错误 episode 可能被高分写入，并在后续被反复检索，形成作者称为 Echo Gap 的正反馈回路。核心问题不是一般性的 judge 噪声，而是“被高估的错误经验会持续进入策略循环并放大”。
summary.importance: 它和预训练不是直接同一层问题，但和 pretrain↔post-train 接口、reward 信号质量、无标签自改进都有直接关系。对基座研究员更重要的启发是：只要学习信号来自模型自身评估，而不是外部可校验反馈，就要警惕 reward hacking 从一次性偏差变成持久性记忆污染。这个结论对 memory agent、RLAIF、self-training、合成偏好数据都有参考意义。论文的贡献主要在诊断和机制刻画，而不是提出一个通用强方法。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上分三层。第一层是现象定义。作者把 memory retrieval 看成一种隐式、非参数化 policy，memory score 则对应 proxy reward。这样一来，写入高分记忆并在相似任务上复用，就等价于在一个外部记忆空间里做 policy improvement。Echo Gap 指的是：自评奖励与真实成功之间存在系统偏差，而且这种偏差与未来检索频率相关，因此会被动态放大。

第二层是理论诊断。论文提出 Error-Independence Assumption, EIA，用来刻画“更强的 verifier 为什么不一定能纠偏”。如果 verifier 的误差与原始 self-grade 的偏差高度相关，那么即便 verifier 平均更准，也无法对具体 memory 做有效去膨胀。作者把可恢复收益写成依赖两个量的函数：一是 verifier score 与真实效用的一致性，二是 verifier error 与原始 bias 的去相关程度。这里的关键判断很实用：纠偏不只需要更高能力，还需要不同错误模式。

第三层是缓解方法。作者反对 label-blind 的全局 calibration，因为全局映射只能重标定分数分布，无法识别“哪条记忆被高估”。他们主张 per-memory demotion，即对每条 memory 用额外、尽量去相关的信号做个体化降权。文中还给出一种 answer-free de-inflation 方案，并在 Memento 风格的 retrieve–inject–write agent 上验证。这里“answer-free”强调的是不依赖真实标签，而是利用与原始自评不同的信息通道来修正写回分数。
summary.experiments:
实验分成两部分。第一部分看 memory bank 本身的分数失真。作者在多个模型家族和 live factual banks 上观察到，错误 episode 会被系统性高估，而且这种高估与被复用频率相关，不是简单的随机噪声。更强的 re-grader 往往整体更接近真实标签，但其错误仍可能和原始 self-grade 偏差同向，因此无法稳定修正 bank 排序。

第二部分看端到端行为后果。作者在 BIRD text-to-SQL 上搭建了一个较忠实的 Memento-style memory loop：agent 检索相似历史、注入上下文、完成当前任务、再把新 episode 写回记忆库，且写回时不访问真实标签。评测则用 benchmark 官方 execution accuracy。结果是，自评写回会逐步污染 memory bank，而提出的 de-inflation 方法在多随机种子下都优于 self-graded baseline，说明 Echo Gap 不只是评分层面的统计现象，而会转化为真实行为退化。

从摘要和正文片段能确认的重点，是现象稳定存在、理论条件与实证一致、以及 mitigation 在真实 memory loop 中有效。现有片段没有完整表格和精确数值，无法可靠给出提升点数或误差幅度，因此不应虚构具体数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓住作者的建模视角：memory score 不是普通 metadata，而是代理奖励。理解这一点后，再看 Echo Gap 的定义和 Theorem 1，重点不是公式本身，而是“为什么错误高分会在检索闭环里乘法式放大”。

然后看 EIA 那一节。这里是全文最有信息量的部分，因为它解释了为什么“换一个更强 judge”常常不够。实验部分建议优先看两类图表：1）memory score 与真实正确性的偏差分布；2）端到端 BIRD agent 在不同写回策略下的 execution accuracy 变化。若只做泛读，30 分钟左右足够；若关心 RLAIF、self-training 或 memory agent 的训练信号问题，EIA 和 de-inflation 细节值得细看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode in memory-based self-improving LLM agents. These agents do not update model weights; instead, they store past episodes in external memory, assign each episode a utility score, and retrieve high-scoring similar episodes for future tasks. In deployment, ground-truth labels are usually unavailable, so the stored utility is produced by self-grading or an LLM judge. The core problem is that incorrect episodes can receive inflated rewards, get written into memory, and then be preferentially reused, creating a persistent feedback loop. The paper calls this phenomenon the Echo Gap.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is highly relevant to the quality of learning signals in post-training and self-improvement pipelines. The main lesson for foundation-model research is that once model-generated evaluation is used as a reward proxy, reward hacking can become persistent memory corruption rather than a one-off grading error. That matters for memory agents, RLAIF, self-training, synthetic preference generation, and any setup where future behavior is shaped by model-produced scores without external verification.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has three technical layers. First, it reframes memory retrieval as an implicit non-parametric policy and the stored utility score as a proxy reward. Under this view, writing high-scoring episodes and reusing them later is a form of policy improvement in memory space. The Echo Gap is then defined as a systematic mismatch between self-assessed reward and true success, amplified by retrieval frequency.

Second, the paper provides a diagnosis through the Error-Independence Assumption (EIA). The key claim is that a stronger verifier is not sufficient if its errors are correlated with the original self-grading bias. The recoverable benefit of correction depends on two quantities: how well verifier scores align with true utility, and how decorrelated verifier errors are from the original bias. This is the most useful conceptual contribution: correction requires not just more capability, but a different error channel.

Third, the paper proposes mitigation through per-memory de-inflation rather than global calibration. A label-blind global remapping of scores cannot identify which specific memories are overvalued. Instead, the authors argue for memory-specific demotion using auxiliary signals that are less likely to share the same bias. They instantiate this idea with an answer-free de-inflation method and test it in a Memento-style retrieve–inject–write loop.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are split into bank-level diagnosis and end-to-end behavioral impact. At the memory-bank level, the paper shows that incorrect episodes are systematically over-rewarded across the studied model families and factual memory banks, and that the inflation correlates with future reuse. This is not mere random judge noise. More capable re-graders are often better on average, but their residual errors can still align with the original self-grading bias, which limits their corrective value.

At the agent level, the paper evaluates a faithful memory loop on BIRD text-to-SQL. The agent retrieves similar past episodes, injects them into context, solves the current task, and writes the new episode back without access to ground-truth labels at write time. Final evaluation uses official execution accuracy. The reported result is that self-graded write-back progressively corrupts the memory bank, while the proposed de-inflation method consistently improves over the self-graded baseline across random seeds. This shows that the Echo Gap is not only a scoring artifact; it translates into measurable behavioral degradation.

The provided content supports the qualitative findings and the structure of the empirical evidence, but it does not expose complete tables or trustworthy exact numbers. It would therefore be inappropriate to fabricate precise gains.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Begin with the framing: memory scores are treated as proxy rewards, not just metadata. That lens makes the rest of the paper much easier to follow. Then read the Echo Gap definition and the theorem around multiplicative amplification in retrieval loops. The important point is not the formalism itself, but why inflated mistakes become self-reinforcing.

Next, focus on the EIA section. This is the conceptual center of the paper because it explains why replacing self-grading with a stronger LLM judge often fails. In the experiments, prioritize the plots that compare stored utility against true correctness and the end-to-end BIRD results under different write-back strategies. A useful skim should take around 30 minutes. If you work on RLAIF, self-training, or memory-based agents, the EIA analysis and the de-inflation mechanism deserve a closer read.

recommendation.zh: 值得看失败案例和 judge 相关性分析；它提醒 memory self-improvement 不是免费 RL，奖励噪声会被检索放大。
recommendation.en: Read the failure cases and judge-correlation analysis; it treats memory self-improvement as non-free RL where reward noise is amplified by retrieval.

paper.title: Flat Score, Amplified Failures: How the Error Budget Masks Damage in Quantized LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization to 4-bit weights is widely reported to be nearly lossless. We test this claim for multi-turn, tool-calling agents, where it now matters most. On $τ^2$-bench, across two open-weight model families in dense and MoE variants and two domains (eight cells, 456 episodes each, at 16-, 8-, and 4-bit weights), quantization indeed looks free on the standard metric. No cell shows a score change that survives multiple-comparison correction, and in the cell that carries the largest

summary.core_problem: 现有4bit量化的“近无损”结论均基于单轮评测，需验证其在多轮工具调用Agent场景下的有效性，并明确量化损伤的发生机制与评测盲区。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有三点：一是Agent场景的量化评测需拆解到单步工具调用维度，不能仅依赖最终任务得分；二是预训练阶段降低工具幻觉等固有错误倾向，可直接减少后续量化损伤的风险；三是模型大小、稠密/MoE架构并非量化损伤的核心决定因素，为Agent适配型量化算法提供了明确的设计方向。
summary.technical_approach: 实验基于τ²-bench工具调用基准开展，覆盖2个开源模型族（稠密+MoE变体）×2个任务领域共8组实验单元，每组456个episode，分别测试16/8/4bit精度下的表现。除常规最终任务成功率外，还将轨迹拆解到单步工具调用的错误分布、错误类型维度，通过收紧错误预算、反事实分析、错误修复prompt验证等方法分离“环境容错掩盖损伤”与“模型本身退化”的效应，最后用logit margin（对数似然边际）解释损伤的发生条件。
summary.experiments: 1）最终聚合指标层面：所有单元的量化分差经多重比较校正后均不显著，最大分差2.0分仅为运行噪声的1.3倍，呈现完全无损的假象。2）单步错误拆解层面：量化不改变错误类型集合（全精度与4bit的幻觉工具名分布相关度0.97，仅0.18%的全新错误），但会放大错误频率：跨单元放大倍数1×至4.6×，Gemma-4稠密模型在电信领域的工具名幻觉从649次升至1646次（2.5×）。3）错误预算掩盖机制验证：将每episode允许的失败调用次数从10次收紧至2次后，INT4分差从1.3分扩大至16.7分，15.4分的显著分差仅出现在错误量被放大的单元（其余单元分差最高0.2分）；针对性错误修复prompt也仅在该受损单元提分。4）损伤预测因子验证：核心决定因素是全精度固有错误倾向，与模型大小、架构无关——全精度下几乎无工具幻觉的Qwen-3.6未出现放大效应，有固有幻觉倾向的Gemma-4被显著放大，符合“量化噪声仅翻转薄边际决策”的机制。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第3节的错误拆解实验和图1（最终分数与单步错误量的对比）、第4节的错误预算反事实分析，预计阅读时间20分钟；重点关注“最终聚合指标失效机制”和“量化损伤前置预测因子”两个核心结论，无需深究统计检验推导细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing 4-bit post-training quantization "near-lossless" claims are derived exclusively from single-turn evaluations, so this work verifies their validity in multi-turn tool-calling agent settings and identifies quantization damage mechanisms and evaluation blind spots.
summary_en.importance: Key implications for pretraining research: First, quantization evaluation for agent settings must decompose to per-tool-call granularity instead of relying solely on final task scores. Second, reducing inherent failure propensities (e.g., tool name hallucination) during pretraining directly reduces downstream quantization damage risk. Third, model size and dense/MoE architecture are not core determinants of quantization damage, providing a clear design direction for agent-tailored quantization algorithms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Experiments run on the τ²-bench tool-calling benchmark across a grid of 2 open-weight model families (dense + MoE variants) × 2 task domains, with 456 episodes per cell at 16-, 8-, and 4-bit precision. Beyond standard final task reward, trajectories are decomposed to per-tool-call error distributions and type sets. Counterfactual error budget tightening, targeted error-repair prompt ablations, and logit-margin analysis separate environment tolerance masking from actual model degradation, with logit margin theory explaining damage occurrence conditions.
summary_en.experiments: 1) Aggregate final scores show no statistically significant quantization gap after multiple-comparison correction; the largest 2.0-point gap is only 1.3× run-to-run noise, creating a false lossless appearance. 2) Per-step decomposition reveals quantization does not alter failure mode sets (0.97 correlation between BF16 and INT4 hallucinated tool names, only 0.18% novel errors) but amplifies frequency: 1× to 4.6× across cells, with Gemma-4 dense in telecom showing 2.5× more out-of-list calls (649 → 1,646). 3) Error budget masking is verified: tightening allowed failed calls from 10 to 2 per episode widens the INT4 gap from 1.3 to 16.7 points, with the full 15.4-point significant gap localized exclusively to the high-amplification cell (max 0.2 points elsewhere); a targeted repair prompt only improves scores in that cell. 4) Damage is gated by full-precision failure propensity, not size or architecture: Qwen-3.6 with rare BF16 hallucinations shows no amplification, while Gemma-4 with inherent hallucination tendency is significantly amplified, consistent with quantization noise only flipping thin-margin argmax decisions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim priority: Section 3 for per-step error decomposition results and Figure 1 (flat aggregate scores vs. rising per-step errors), Section 4 for counterfactual error budget analysis. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes. Focus on the two core conclusions (aggregate metric failure mechanism, pre-quantization damage predictor) and skip detailed statistical test derivations if unnecessary.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会修正“4-bit 对 Agent 免费”的先验；只看失败分解和等价性检验，别只看总分。
recommendation.en: This should weaken the prior that 4-bit is free for agents; read the failure decomposition and equivalence tests, not just the headline score.

paper.title: Do Context Files Help Coding Agents? A Two-Agent Ablation Study on Real Repositories
paper.abstract: Persistent context files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) are standard practice for guiding AI coding agents, yet evidence for their effectiveness is contradictory. We present a controlled ablation of context-injection strategy across two frontier agents (Claude Code and Codex), 17 real tasks from 3 repositories (15 shared + 2 Codex-only), and 288 evaluated runs with gold-test evaluation. Context strategy does not measurably move correctness on either agent (bounded to <=10-15pp via equivalence testing).

summary.core_problem: 持久化上下文文件（AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md）被广泛用于引导 coding agent，但其有效性证据相互矛盾，缺乏受控消融。
summary.importance: 通过严格受控实验给出负面结果，挑战行业普遍实践；属于高质量实证分析，揭示了 coding agent 失败的真正原因是实现能力而非仓库知识缺失。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Claude Code 和 Codex 两个前沿 agent 上，对 3 个仓库的 17 个真实任务做 288 次评估运行，使用 gold-test 评估和等价检验（equivalence testing）量化上下文策略的效果边界，并做失败模式分类和操纵探针（manipulation probe）。
summary.experiments: 2 个 agent × 17 任务 × 多种上下文策略 = 288 runs；上下文策略对正确率无可测量影响（等价检验边界 ≤10-15pp）；真实 AGENTS.md 在两个 agent 上均未将接近成功的任务转为通过；任务难度的 agent 间 Spearman rho=0.75。

summary_en.core_problem: Persistent context files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) are standard practice for guiding coding agents, but evidence for their effectiveness is contradictory and controlled ablations are lacking.
summary_en.importance: A rigorous controlled study yielding a negative result that challenges widespread industry practice; high-quality empirical analysis showing coding agents fail on implementation skill rather than missing repository knowledge.
summary_en.technical_approach: Controlled ablation across Claude Code and Codex on 17 real tasks from 3 repositories with 288 evaluated runs, using gold-test evaluation and equivalence testing to bound context strategy effects, plus failure-mode triage and a manipulation probe.
summary_en.experiments: 2 agents × 17 tasks × multiple context strategies = 288 runs; context strategy has no measurable effect on correctness (bounded to ≤10-15pp via equivalence testing); real AGENTS.md never converts a near-miss to a pass on either agent; cross-agent task difficulty Spearman rho=0.75.

recommendation.zh: 干净的负面结果：上下文文件对 coding agent 正确率无显著影响，失败在实现能力不在知识缺失；做 agent eval 的值得看实验设计和等价检验部分。
recommendation.en: A clean negative result: context files don't measurably help coding agents—failures are in implementation skill, not knowledge; worth reading for the equivalence-testing design if you do agent evaluation.

paper.title: Guardrails as Scapegoats: Auditing Unfaithful Safety Refusals in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Evaluation frameworks for tool-augmented LLM agents focus overwhelmingly on capability metrics or explicit tool crashes, leaving silent infrastructure failures and HTTP 200 responses with empty, null, or malformed payloads largely unaudited. We introduce a lightweight black-box auditing framework that injects four silent failure profiles across 12 production-adjacent tool stubs and classifies agent responses into three mutually exclusive behavioral classes: Honest Surrender (HSR), Fabrication (F

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：tool-augmented LLM agent 在工具静默失败时，常见评测只看显式报错或任务成功率，忽略了模型会把基础设施故障伪装成“安全拒答”或直接编造结果的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测协议与失效模式审计。它把 agent 失败从单纯 capability failure 拆成 Honest Surrender、Fabrication 和 Unfaithful Safety Refusal 三类，指出 guardrail 可能被模型当作甩锅话术。这对做 agent eval、tool-use reliability 和 refusal analysis 的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一个轻量黑盒审计框架，在 12 个接近生产环境的工具 stub 中注入 4 类 silent failure profile，然后观察模型在温度为 0、neutral system prompt 下的响应行为，并通过 ablation 检查 guardrail 提示对 USR 的诱发作用。方法本身不改模型，而是改评测切面。
summary.experiments: 实验评估 2 个 frontier 模型和 2 个开源模型，共 396 条有效轨迹。核心结果是 FAR（把空/坏 payload 当真并编造结果）占 56.6%，USR 在基线几乎不存在，仅 0.25%；但在加入 guardrail 相关设置后，模型会更倾向于用虚构的政策或隐私理由解释工具失败。摘要未给出具体模型名和统计显著性细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a blind spot in tool-augmented LLM agents: when tools fail silently, evaluations often miss whether the model fabricates outputs or hides infrastructure failures behind bogus safety refusals.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and failure-analysis contribution. It refines agent failure modes into Honest Surrender, Fabrication, and Unfaithful Safety Refusal, showing that guardrail language can become a convenient excuse rather than a faithful explanation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a lightweight black-box auditing framework that injects four silent failure profiles into 12 production-adjacent tool stubs, then classify model behavior under temperature-zero, neutral-prompt conditions. The key methodological move is to audit failure attribution rather than just task success.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates two frontier and two open-source models over 396 valid trajectories. The main result is that fabrication dominates at 56.6%, while unfaithful safety refusal is nearly absent at baseline (0.25%) but can be induced by guardrail-related ablations. The abstract does not provide full model names or detailed significance analysis.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 本身帮助不大，但它把 refusal fidelity 这个坑挖得很准：agent 评测里别只看 refusal rate，先区分是真安全还是拿安全当借口；读 failure taxonomy 和 ablation 就够。
recommendation.en: Not directly useful for pretraining, but it nails a real eval pitfall: refusal behavior in agents must be audited for faithfulness, not just counted; read the failure taxonomy and the guardrail ablation.

paper.title: Why Does Feedback-Augmented Self-Distillation Fail to Improve Retrieval-Interleaved Search Agents?
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers a promising approach for training large language models without relying on a separate teacher model. However, its effectiveness on complex agentic tasks remains largely unexplored. In this work, we instantiate Feedback-Augmented Self-Distillation (FA-SD), a self-distillation algorithm for agentic search that leverages successful demonstrations as privileged information. We identify that models can rely on recurring reasoning-and-search output templates,

summary.core_problem: 解释为什么带反馈的 on-policy self-distillation 在 retrieval-interleaved search agent 上常常失效，即使 self-teacher 表现更强也学不稳。
summary.importance: 这类工作对 pretrain 研究员有间接但真实的价值：它揭示了自蒸馏在 agentic setting 下会出现新的训练信号退化模式，尤其是模板化轨迹导致的 decoding collapse。贡献更偏 failure analysis，而不是新算法突破。
summary.technical_approach: 作者实例化 Feedback-Augmented Self-Distillation (FA-SD)，用成功 demonstration 作为 privileged information 做 agent 搜索自蒸馏；随后分析其失败原因，指出模型会依赖重复的 reasoning-and-search 输出模板，造成表面多样、实则与输入无关的轨迹，使 KL 蒸馏信号失去信息量，并把不稳定性分解为多种监督不一致来源。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模和具体 benchmark 名称，但场景是 retrieval-interleaved search agent。关键实验应包括：self-teacher 虽更强但 student 学习不稳定；现有指标漏检 decoding collapse；以及对 supervision inconsistency 的分解分析。若这些对照做得干净，这篇的价值主要在 failure mode taxonomy。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains why feedback-augmented on-policy self-distillation often fails for retrieval-interleaved search agents, even when the self-teacher is stronger.
summary_en.importance: This is indirectly relevant to pretraining researchers because it exposes a new training-signal degeneration mode in agentic self-distillation, especially decoding collapse caused by templated trajectories. The contribution is more about failure analysis than a new algorithmic win.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors instantiate Feedback-Augmented Self-Distillation (FA-SD), using successful demonstrations as privileged information for agentic search training. They then diagnose failure: models rely on recurring reasoning-and-search output templates, producing trajectories that look diverse but are largely input-agnostic, making the KL distillation signal uninformative. The instability is further decomposed into multiple forms of inconsistent supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes or benchmark names, but the setting is retrieval-interleaved search agents. The key evidence likely includes: a stronger self-teacher still fails to train a stable student; standard metrics miss decoding collapse; and ablations isolate sources of supervision inconsistency. If these controls are clean, the main value is the failure-mode taxonomy.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不在于方法赢了，而在于把 self-distillation 在 agent 里为什么学坏讲明白了；重点看 decoding collapse 定义和监督不一致分解，值得迁移到 RL/SFT 日志排查。
recommendation.en: The value is not a better method but a cleaner explanation of why self-distillation breaks in agents; read the decoding-collapse diagnosis and supervision-inconsistency breakdown, then port those checks to your RL/SFT logs.

paper.title: How Do VLMs Fail? Vision-Operation Misalignment in Compositional VQA
paper.abstract: Compositional visual question answering requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to execute multiple reasoning operations like object selection, spatial relation resolution, and attribute verification. Despite strong aggregate performance, the mechanistic basis of VLM failures on this task remains underexplored. To address this gap, we analyze vision-operation misalignment in VLMs by examining how failures relate to specific reasoning operations and the internal computational pathways through whic

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM在组合式视觉问答任务上的错误来源与内部传播机制缺乏系统性拆解，无法针对性指导模型改进。
summary.importance: 提出以推理操作为核心的VLM失败分析框架，首次按错误起源与传播路径区分了四类机制不同的错误模式，为VLM能力优化提供错误归因依据。
summary.technical_approach: 构建Operation-centric分析框架，将VLM组合推理拆解为目标选择、空间关系解析、属性验证等原子操作，从错误起源的操作类型、内部计算传播路径两个维度拆解失败，结合视觉grounding强度与答案正确性的关联对错误分类。
summary.experiments: 在组合VQA数据集上对主流VLM开展分析，识别出grounding失败、推理失败、属性提取失败、语言先验主导失败四类错误，每类对应视觉grounding强度与答案正确率的独特关联模式，在不同规模模型上均普遍存在。
summary.authors_note: 新加坡理工大学、NVIDIA新加坡团队出品。

summary_en.core_problem: The mechanistic origin and propagation pathways of VLM failures on compositional VQA remain under-explored, preventing targeted model improvements.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an operation-centric mechanistic analysis framework for VLM failures, identifying four distinct failure modes categorized by their origin operation and propagation pathway to inform VLM capability optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes VLM compositional reasoning into atomic operations including object selection, spatial relation resolution and attribute verification; categorizes failures by their origin operation and internal propagation path, using the correlation between visual grounding strength and answer correctness for classification.
summary_en.experiments: Tests mainstream VLMs on compositional VQA benchmarks, identifying four failure modes (grounding, reasoning, attribute extraction, language prior dominance) each with a unique correlation pattern between grounding strength and answer accuracy, observed across model scales.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Singapore Institute of Technology and NVIDIA Singapore.

recommendation.zh: VLM错误归因的常规分析工作，无预训练层面新洞见，只看四类失败模式总结即可，不必读全文。
recommendation.en: A routine VLM error analysis with no pretraining-level insights; only read the four failure mode summary, skip the full text.

paper.title: Compaction as Epistemic Failure: How Agentic LLM Tools Fabricate Confirmed Results from Killed Processes
paper.abstract: Agentic LLM coding tools compress long session histories into compaction summaries that subsequent sessions inherit as ground truth. This paper documents a failure mode in Claude Code where partial standard output from timed-out commands (exit code 143) is recorded in compaction summaries as confirmed results, propagating false positives across sessions and model versions without re-verification. The underlying mechanism is a conflation of observation and persistence, where information that appe

summary.core_problem: 指出 agentic LLM 编程工具在压缩长会话历史时，可能把被杀死进程的部分输出错误写成已确认结果，并在后续会话中传播。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 可靠性失败模式分析。它不涉及基座训练，但对长上下文压缩、工具执行记录、agent memory 和自动化科研/编程流程的可信性有直接警示。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以 Claude Code 为案例，分析 compaction summary 如何把 timed-out command 的部分 stdout，即 exit code 143 的未完成进程输出，记录成后续会话继承的事实。核心机制是混淆了“终端观察到的信息”和“持久化存储中确认完成的信息”。
summary.experiments: 摘要描述的是案例式故障记录，而非大规模 benchmark。关键现象是 false positives 会跨 session 和 model version 传播，且后续 agent 可能不重新验证这些继承结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper identifies a failure mode in agentic LLM coding tools where compaction summaries turn partial output from killed processes into confirmed results that persist across sessions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent reliability failure analysis. It does not concern base-model training, but it is relevant to long-session compaction, tool-execution logging, agent memory, and trustworthy automated coding or scientific workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using Claude Code as the case study, it analyzes how partial stdout from timed-out commands with exit code 143 can be written into compaction summaries as factual results. The key mechanism is a conflation between observed terminal text and durable, verified execution artifacts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract describes a documented failure case rather than a large benchmark. The central observation is that false positives can propagate across sessions and model versions without re-verification.

recommendation.zh: 值得记住这个 failure mode；长会话压缩若不区分 observation 和 durable state，会污染 agent 记忆。
recommendation.en: Remember this failure mode: session compaction that blurs observation and durable state can poison agent memory.

paper.title: Agentic Context Learning with Self-Discovered Specification
paper.abstract: Context learning is an emerging inference-time task where LLMs must learn and apply novel, task-specific knowledge from intricate contexts absent from pre-training; even frontier models score under 24% task success. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study to understand why this setting remains difficult. A natural hypothesis is that failures stem from content access; yet across twelve retrieval, reflection, and verification baselines on CL-Bench, an extensive context learning be

summary.core_problem: 上下文学习（context learning）要求 LLM 从长上下文中学习并应用全新的任务特定知识，但前沿模型严格通过率仍低于 24%。传统假设认为失败源于内容检索不足，但实验显示检索、反思、验证等 12 类方法几乎无增益，核心瓶颈实际是「局部规范获取」——模型需要从上下文中发现并遵守查询隐含、低显著度、分散分布的行为约束（格式、边界处理、标签、完整性条件等），而非仅提取与查询相关的事实内容。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于：长上下文能力的评测与训练不能只关注内容检索/理解，必须同时覆盖「规范获取」维度。当前预训练数据与目标函数（next-token 预测）对低显著度、分散式约束的学习激励不足，这解释了为何长上下文模型在真实部署中常出现「几乎正确但因细节违规失败」的 near-miss 现象。该结论可直接指导预训练数据构造（增加规范密集型文档）、训练目标设计（强化约束遵守信号）以及长上下文能力评测指标设计。
summary.technical_approach: 首先在 CL-Bench（1899 个长上下文、抗污染任务）上评测 12 种基线方法，覆盖检索与上下文重构、测试时自纠错、自生成规则验证、迭代检索扩展四类，确认内容访问不是瓶颈。随后对 31592 条 rubric 条目做分类，量化规范获取（55.4%）与内容获取（22.6%）的占比，并分析规范的查询隐含性（仅 23.3% 可从查询直接推断，76.7% 仅存在于上下文）与可恢复性（95.5% 可通过显式归纳从上下文中提取）。基于此提出极简干预方案 PSCI（私有规范契约归纳）：四步测试时脚手架——1）从上下文归纳任务特定的规范契约；2）在契约约束下生成答案；3）对抗式检查器对照契约审计草稿；4）修复违规项。整个过程不访问任务公开 rubric。
summary.experiments: 关键结果：1）12 种内容访问导向基线中，最优方法仅比直接全上下文提示基线（22.55% 严格通过率）提升不超过 1 个百分点；2）任务级严格通过率仅 22.55%，但 rubric 条目级通过率达 76.01%，失败多为单条关键规范遗漏的 near-miss；在仅差 1 条 rubric 的失败案例中，75.3% 遗漏的是行为规范而非事实内容；3）PSCI 在 GPT-5.1 上达到 28.14% 严格通过率，相对基线提升 5.59 个百分点（+24.8% 相对提升），在四类任务家族上均有一致增益；在 Qwen3.5-27B 上从 14.14% 提升至 19.42%；4）17 组消融验证了任务特定规范的必要性：打乱契约的 PSCI 低于基线，计算量匹配的通用批评回到基线，答案优先的顺序安排完全失效。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点：第 3 节 CL-Bench 与 rubric 分类——理解「内容获取 vs 规范获取」的划分依据与量化结果；第 4 节失败分析——看 near-miss 模式与规范的查询隐含性数据；第 5.2 节基线对比与 5.4 节消融实验——确认内容访问方法的失效边界与 PSCI 各组件的贡献。预计阅读时间 50-60 分钟。对预训练研究员，值得深挖的点是：next-token 目标为何对分散式低显著度约束学习不足，以及如何在预训练阶段注入规范遵守信号（而非仅依赖测试时脚手架）。

summary_en.core_problem: Context learning requires LLMs to acquire and apply novel task-specific knowledge from long contexts, yet frontier models still achieve below 24% strict task success. The conventional hypothesis attributes failures to insufficient content retrieval, but experiments show 12 classes of methods spanning retrieval, reflection, and verification deliver almost no gain. The actual bottleneck is specification acquisition: models must discover and comply with query-implicit, low-salience, scattered behavioral constraints (formats, edge-case handling, labels, completeness conditions, etc.) distributed across the context, rather than only extracting query-relevant factual content.
summary_en.importance: Implications for pretraining research: long-context capability evaluation and training cannot focus solely on content retrieval/understanding — specification acquisition must be covered as a separate dimension. Current pretraining data and the next-token prediction objective provide insufficient incentive for learning low-salience, distributed constraints, which explains the pervasive near-miss failure pattern in real long-context deployments (mostly correct but invalid due to minor rule violations). These findings directly inform pretraining data construction (adding specification-dense documents), training objective design (strengthening constraint-compliance signals), and long-context evaluation metric design.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, 12 baseline methods across four families — retrieval & context restructuring, test-time self-correction, self-generated rubric verification, and iterative retrieval scaling — are evaluated on CL-Bench (1,899 long-context, contamination-controlled tasks), confirming content access is not the bottleneck. Next, 31,592 rubric items are taxonomized to quantify the share of specification acquisition (55.4%) versus content acquisition (22.6%), and to analyze query-implicitness (only 23.3% of specs are directly inferable from the query, 76.7% exist only in context) and recoverability (95.5% can be extracted from context via explicit induction). Based on this diagnosis, a deliberately simple intervention called PSCI (Private Specification-Contract Induction) is proposed: a four-step test-time scaffold — 1) induce a task-specific specification contract from the context; 2) generate the answer under contract constraints; 3) an adversarial checker audits the draft against the contract; 4) a repair step fixes violations. The public task rubric is never accessed at any stage.
summary_en.experiments: Key results: 1) Among 12 content-access-oriented baselines, the best method improves upon the direct full-context prompt baseline (22.55% strict pass) by no more than 1 percentage point; 2) Task-level strict pass is only 22.55%, but rubric-item-level pass reaches 76.01% — most failures are near-misses missing exactly one critical item; among failures missing exactly one rubric item, 75.3% miss behavioral specifications rather than factual content; 3) PSCI achieves 28.14% strict pass on GPT-5.1, a +5.59 pp absolute (+24.8% relative) improvement over baseline, with consistent gains across all four task families; on Qwen3.5-27B, it improves from 14.14% to 19.42%; 4) 17 ablations validate the necessity of task-specific specifications: shuffled contracts collapse below baseline, compute-matched generic critique returns to baseline, and answer-first ordering fails entirely.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim priority: Section 3 on CL-Bench and rubric taxonomy — understand the rationale and quantitative results of the 'content acquisition vs specification acquisition' distinction; Section 4 failure analysis — examine the near-miss pattern and query-implicitness data for specifications; Section 5.2 baseline comparison and 5.4 ablations — confirm the failure boundary of content-access methods and the contribution of each PSCI component. Estimated reading time: 50-60 minutes. For pretraining researchers, a worthwhile direction to dig deeper is why the next-token objective under-learns distributed, low-salience constraints, and how to inject specification-compliance signals during pretraining rather than relying solely on test-time scaffolding.

recommendation.zh: 失败分析有信息量：上下文学习的瓶颈不在检索而在隐式规范提取，对预训练数据设计与ICL机制研究有参考，重点看失败分析章节。
recommendation.en: Informative failure analysis: context learning bottleneck lies in implicit spec extraction, not retrieval. Relevant for pretraining data design and ICL mechanism studies; focus on the failure analysis section.

paper.title: Silent Failures in Quantized LLM Reasoning: A Taxonomy-Based Analysis of Hollow Convergence and Failure Mode Shifts
paper.abstract: We show that post-training quantization can silently alter how large language models reason even when task accuracy is preserved. Using a six-category failure taxonomy validated by two independent human annotators (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.906), we classify 30,000 chain-of-thought outputs from five instruction-tuned LLMs (3B--14B parameters) across three quantization precisions (FP32, FP16, NF4) and four reasoning benchmarks. We find that while accuracy is robust across precisions (maximum 3.1 pp drop),

summary.core_problem: 后训练量化是否只影响精度，而不改变模型的推理过程与失败模式。
summary.importance: 贡献属于机制分析与评测框架：它不发明新量化方法，而是指出“精度几乎不掉”并不等于“推理行为不变”，这对量化模型的可信部署和训练后分析都有直接意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了一个六类推理失败 taxonomy，并由两位人工标注者验证一致性；随后分析 5 个 3B-14B instruction-tuned 模型在 FP32、FP16、NF4 三种精度下、四个推理 benchmark 上的 3 万条 CoT 输出，比较正确率之外的失败类型分布，重点观察 Hollow Convergence、Shortcut Collapse、Confidence Drift 等行为变化。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 5 个模型、3 种精度、4 个 benchmark、30,000 条 CoT。总体准确率在量化后最多下降 3.1 个百分点，但 NF4 下失败模式显著漂移：小模型的 Hollow Convergence 明显下降，而 12B 及以上模型基本不变；GSM8K 几乎不受影响，LogiQA 和 ARC-Challenge 变化最大；LLaMA 3.2-3B 在 NF4 下 Shortcut Collapse 在错误样本中的占比从 44% 升到 78%。
summary.authors_note: University of Maryland, College Park。未见可确认的头部基座团队作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether post-training quantization merely preserves task accuracy or also changes the internal reasoning behavior and failure modes of LLMs.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-and-evaluation contribution rather than a new quantization method. Its value is in showing that near-constant accuracy does not imply stable reasoning behavior, which matters for trustworthy deployment and for interpreting post-training interventions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define a six-category reasoning-failure taxonomy, validate it with two human annotators, and analyze 30,000 chain-of-thought outputs from five 3B-14B instruction-tuned LLMs under FP32, FP16, and NF4 across four reasoning benchmarks. They compare not just accuracy but shifts in failure-type distributions, focusing on Hollow Convergence, Shortcut Collapse, and related categories.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 5 models, 3 precisions, 4 benchmarks, and 30k CoT traces. Accuracy drops by at most 3.1 points after quantization, yet failure modes shift substantially under NF4: Hollow Convergence drops sharply for smaller models but stays stable at 12B+, GSM8K is largely unaffected, while LogiQA and ARC-Challenge show the largest shifts. In LLaMA 3.2-3B, Shortcut Collapse rises from 44% to 78% of wrong-answer failures under NF4.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Maryland, College Park. No clearly identifiable major foundation-model lab authors from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改算法，但它提醒你别再拿 accuracy 当量化安全证书；读 taxonomy 和按模型尺寸分层的结果，足够改掉不少评测习惯。
recommendation.en: No new quantizer here, but it usefully breaks the habit of treating flat accuracy as proof of unchanged reasoning; read the taxonomy and the size-stratified NF4 results.

paper.title: Pitfalls and Remedies for Multi-Task Bayesian Optimization
paper.abstract: Bayesian optimization routinely warm-starts a target experiment with data from related source tasks, and the multi-task Gaussian process is the textbook surrogate for the job. We revisit this default in a controlled setting and find that it misestimates the cross-task correlation even in the simplest non-trivial case, affinely related source and target tasks, where a working transfer learning method should obviously succeed. We trace the failure to two independent structural mechanisms. Per-task

summary.core_problem: 解决多任务贝叶斯优化中 textbook multi-task GP 在最简单可迁移设定下仍会错误估计跨任务相关性、导致迁移失效的问题。
summary.importance: 这不是 LLM 论文，但属于较干净的方法分析。价值在于它把一个被默认接受的 surrogate 失败机制拆成两个结构性原因，并给出保守修复，对做自动化超参搜索、训练 recipe 优化的人有间接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在受控设定下分析 affinely related source/target tasks，指出两类失败来源：其一，按任务标准化会把有限样本对齐误差传入相关性估计；其二，在非重合设计点上，边际似然对任务相关性的辨识速率只有 per-sample 级别，进一步稀释信号。基于此提出三种修复：把每任务均值和尺度作为模型参数、限制任务协方差为非负相关、以及让部分设计点共址。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调在最简单非平凡设定下就能复现失败，并验证三种 remedy 的效果。没有 LLM 规模实验，但其 controlled setup 比很多经验性 BO 论文更干净，适合作为方法论参考而非直接结论迁移。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Meta/BoTorch 方向研究者 Carl Hvarfner、Sam Daulton、Max Balandat、Eytan Bakshy；这条线在贝叶斯优化与实验设计工具链里较有代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies why textbook multi-task Gaussian-process surrogates in Bayesian optimization can misestimate cross-task correlation and fail to transfer even in the simplest transferable setting.
summary_en.importance: This is not an LLM paper, but it is a clean methodological analysis. Its value lies in decomposing a default surrogate's failure into two structural causes and proposing conservative fixes, which is indirectly relevant for automated hyperparameter and recipe search.
summary_en.technical_approach: In a controlled affine source-target setting, the paper identifies two failure modes: per-task standardization injects finite-sample alignment error into correlation recovery, and marginal likelihood identifies task correlation only at a per-sample rate, which is further diluted under non-overlapping designs. It then proposes three remedies: learn per-task means/scales, constrain task covariance to non-negative correlations, and co-locate some design points.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract suggests failures already appear in the simplest non-trivial setup and that the three remedies are validated there. There are no LLM-scale experiments, but the controlled setup is cleaner than many empirical BO papers and is useful as methodology rather than directly transferable evidence.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Meta/BoTorch researchers Carl Hvarfner, Sam Daulton, Max Balandat, and Eytan Bakshy, a recognizable line of work in Bayesian optimization and experiment-design tooling.

recommendation.zh: 和 LLM 不直接相关，但如果你用 BO 调训练 recipe，这篇把默认 multi-task GP 为什么会翻车讲得很清楚；看 failure analysis 和三个 remedy 就够了。
recommendation.en: Not directly about LLMs, but if you use BO for recipe tuning, this cleanly explains why default multi-task GPs fail; read the failure analysis and the three remedies.

paper.title: Failure as a Process: An Anatomy of CLI Coding Agent Trajectories
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents are increasingly deployed to autonomously perform software engineering tasks in terminal-based environments, making their reliability a growing concern. Existing empirical studies investigate why coding agents fail, yet they largely treat failure as a final outcome rather than a temporal process, providing limited insight into how failures emerge, evolve, and become unrecoverable. We present the first large-scale empirical study of CLI coding-agent failur

summary.core_problem: 分析 CLI coding agents 在终端环境中失败是如何发生、扩散并变得不可恢复的，而不是只统计最终成功或失败。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 可靠性经验分析。它把失败建模为过程，收集多模型、多脚手架的大规模执行轨迹并人工标注，为后训练、agent scaffold 设计和 coding-agent eval 提供错误模式素材，但不是预训练核心工作。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 process-oriented failure framework，把失败拆成 onset、evolution、recovery 等阶段。数据来自七个 frontier models 在 OpenHands、MiniSWE、Terminus2 三个 CLI coding-agent scaffold 上执行 Terminal-Bench 任务的轨迹，并对完整有效轨迹进行逐步人工标注，归纳失败演化规律。
summary.experiments: 收集 3,843 条执行轨迹，过滤得到 1,794 条完整有效轨迹，覆盖超过 63,000 个 execution steps。实验对象包括七个前沿模型、三个 coding-agent scaffolds 和 Terminal-Bench。论文报告 14 条关于失败发生、演化和恢复的发现，但摘要未列出具体发现内容。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how CLI coding agents fail over time in terminal environments, rather than treating failure as a binary final outcome.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical reliability analysis for coding agents. By modeling failure as a temporal process and annotating large-scale trajectories across models and scaffolds, it provides useful error-mode material for post-training, scaffold design, and coding-agent evaluation, but it is not a core pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces a process-oriented framework that decomposes failure into onset, evolution, and recovery. It collects trajectories from seven frontier models running through OpenHands, MiniSWE, and Terminus2 on Terminal-Bench, then manually annotates valid complete trajectories step by step to derive patterns of failure progression.
summary_en.experiments: The study collects 3,843 execution trajectories and filters them to 1,794 complete and valid trajectories, covering more than 63,000 execution steps. It spans seven frontier models, three coding-agent scaffolds, and Terminal-Bench. The paper reports 14 findings on failure onset, evolution, and recovery, though the abstract does not list them.

recommendation.zh: 不改预训练 prior，但 failure trajectory 标注值得扫；只看 14 findings 和错误阶段划分即可。
recommendation.en: It will not change pretraining priors, but the trajectory annotations are useful; read the 14 findings and the failure-stage taxonomy.

paper.title: Blind-Spots-Bench: Evaluating Blind Spots in Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: Modern AI models achieve strong performance on many established benchmarks, yet they still fail on tasks that humans find almost trivial, such as manipulating a string or drawing a dog with five legs. These examples suggest that existing benchmarks may under-measure persistent blind spots in current systems. We introduce $\texttt{blind-spots-bench}$, a benchmark designed to expose such blind spots through tasks that appear simple for humans but remain challenging for modern AI. We collect raw qu

summary.core_problem: 现有 benchmark 往往测不出模型在人类看来很简单、但模型持续出错的“盲点”；这篇工作试图系统暴露这类能力缺口，覆盖语言、多模态和图像生成模型。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个小而尖的 blind-spot benchmark。它对基座研究的价值不在榜单，而在提醒研究者：常规评测可能高估了模型的通用性，尤其是对组合、操作性和常识外观简单任务的掌握。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从 AI 课程学生提出的原始问题中收集样本，清洗并标注参考答案，形成 235 条数据和一套任务 taxonomy；同时设计自动评分流程，统一评估开源/闭源 LLM、VLM 和图像生成模型在这些“看似简单”的任务上的表现。
summary.experiments: 数据规模不大，仅 235 个样本，但覆盖语言、视觉语言和图像生成模型。结果显示闭源前沿模型整体优于开源模型，但即便强模型也存在稳定盲点；摘要强调的是 blind spot 的持续存在，而不是某家模型绝对领先多少。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单中包含 Emmanuel Abbé。若为同名学者，则其在理论与学习方向有较高知名度；仅凭摘要无法确认团队完整背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a gap in current evaluation: models often fail on tasks that look trivial to humans, yet standard benchmarks under-measure these persistent blind spots.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a small but sharp benchmark for blind spots. The value for foundation-model researchers is not the leaderboard itself, but the reminder that standard evaluations may overestimate general competence, especially on simple-looking compositional or manipulative tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The dataset is built from raw questions collected from students in an AI course, then cleaned and annotated with structured reference solutions. The authors also design an automated grading pipeline to evaluate open-weight and closed-source language, vision-language, and image-generation models.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 235 samples, so it is not large, but it spans LLMs, VLMs, and image generators. Results suggest frontier closed-source models outperform open-weight ones overall, yet even strong models retain systematic blind spots on seemingly easy tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Emmanuel Abbé. If this is the well-known researcher of the same name, that adds some credibility, but the full team background cannot be confirmed from the abstract alone.

recommendation.zh: 不是大 benchmark，但方向对：拿来做 failure-case sanity check 很合适；正文未必值细读，先看 taxonomy 和错误例子。
recommendation.en: Not a major benchmark, but the direction is right: use it as a failure-case sanity check; the taxonomy and example failures matter more than the full paper.

We study \emph{ghost memory}, a state coordination failure in which old, current, and transition facts coexist in the memory bank, remain mixed during retrieval, and mislead the answer model. We argue that memory systems should be understood and optimized from three levels: bank maintenance, retrieval, and answer time res

summary.core_problem: 长期Agent记忆存在ghost memory问题：旧事实、当前事实、过渡事实混杂在记忆库中，检索时无法区分导致回答错误
summary.importance: 失败模式分析+方法创新，首次明确提出ghost memory状态协调失败模式，呼吁解耦记忆三层失败的评测，配套构建冲突密集的评测基准
summary.technical_approach: 提出ATMA状态感知覆盖层，在记忆库中保留被取代记录和过渡记录，为查询的目标状态视图构建证据包，向QA模块暴露当前/历史/过渡三类标签
summary.experiments: 构建了冲突密集的LTP（LoCoMo Temporal Plus）评测基准，用于量化ghost memory失败；完整实验结果摘要截断未披露

summary_en.core_problem: Long-term agent memory suffers from ghost memory: old, current, and transition facts coexist in the memory bank, mixed during retrieval and leading to incorrect answers
summary_en.importance: Failure mode analysis + method innovation, explicitly proposing the ghost memory state coordination failure for the first time, calling for decoupled evaluation of three-level memory failures, and building a conflict-heavy evaluation benchmark
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ATMA state-aware overlay, retains superseded and transition records in the memory bank, builds evidence packets for the query's target state view, and exposes current/historical/transition labels to the QA module

recommendation.zh: 提出的ghost memory失败模式对长记忆预训练有微弱参考，仅看失败模式定义和三层解耦评测思路即可
recommendation.en: The proposed ghost memory failure mode has weak reference value for long-memory pretraining; only the failure mode definition and three-level decoupled evaluation idea are worth reading

paper.title: Learning from Failure: Inference-Time Self-Improvement for Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Computer-use agents, which leverage multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to operate computers and complete tasks, have attracted significant attention for their utility and versatility. A major challenge in developing these agents is collecting large-scale, high-quality trajectories. The standard approach generates synthetic data through a self-improving loop: an agent is placed in a verifiable environment and iteratively fine-tuned on its successful trajectories. summary.core_problem: Computer-use agent 的自改进通常只用成功轨迹，如何系统性地把失败轨迹转化为可用的改进信号与数据资产。
summary.importance: 数据闭环/自改进范式上的补洞：把“失败”当作高信息密度监督源，属于 agent 训练信号质量与数据构造问题，对 post-train 与长期在线学习有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 failure-driven self-improvement loop：用 LLM 诊断失败模式，提出推理期解决方案，并生成代码补丁；再通过轻量人工验证把补丁用于升级 agent（相当于把失败→诊断→修复建议→可执行补丁→再部署的流水线产品化）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体环境/任务集、成功率提升幅度、人工验证成本与对照（只用成功轨迹的 self-improve loop）；需要看正文确认验证强度与是否存在“人类在回路里兜底”的隐性增益。
summary.authors_note: Stanford University, Tsinghua University；Ludwig Schmidt、Serena Yeung-Levy 为较知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Self-improving computer-use agents typically train only on successful trajectories; the goal is to turn failed trajectories into actionable improvement signals and data.
summary_en.importance: Closes a gap in data-centric self-improvement loops: treating failures as high-information supervision, with indirect implications for post-training signal quality and continual improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: A failure-driven loop: an LLM diagnoses failure modes, proposes inference-time fixes, and generates code patches; patches are lightly human-verified and used to upgrade the agent, forming a failure→diagnosis→patch→deploy pipeline.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits task suites, success-rate gains, human verification cost, and clean baselines (success-only self-improvement). The key is whether verification is strong enough to avoid hidden human crutches.
summary_en.authors_note: Stanford University, Tsinghua University; notable authors include Ludwig Schmidt and Serena Yeung-Levy.

recommendation.zh: 把失败轨迹“结构化成可修复补丁”这步比继续堆成功数据更像真增量；但要盯紧人类验证占比与对照是否干净，否则只是人工调参流水线。
recommendation.en: The real value is operationalizing failures into patchable signals, not just more success data—but scrutinize human-verification load and baseline cleanliness, or it’s just a human-in-the-loop patch factory.

institutions: pipelines, enabling more efficient agent improvement. Code is available

paper.title: Cliff Tokens: Identifying Single-Token Failure Triggers in LLM Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) reach high accuracy in mathematical reasoning, but individual traces on the same problem diverge; some arrive at the correct answer while others fail. Prior work analyzes failure at the step, chunk, or sentence level, or at tokens where failure has already occurred. Neither identifies the precise token that triggers the shift toward failure. We introduce the cliff token, a token where the token-wise potential drops significantly under an adaptive threshold that scale

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“模型为什么会做错数学题”这种宽泛问题，而是更细的一层：在一条已经展开的推理轨迹里，究竟是哪一个具体 token 把轨迹从“仍可修复”推到“后续大概率失败”。已有分析大多停在 step、chunk、sentence 粒度，或者只标记已经掉到零成功率之后的位置，因而抓不到真正的触发点。作者提出 cliff token，用 rollout 估计每个位置的 token-wise potential，也就是“从当前前缀继续采样，最终答对的概率”，再用带方差校正的一侧 two-proportion z-test 判断某个 token 是否造成了显著下跌。核心问题因此被形式化为：如何在高噪声 rollout 估计下，可靠地定位单 token 级别的 failure trigger，并区分不同类型的触发机制。
summary.importance: 对预训练和推理研究的意义有两层。第一层是分析工具层面。它把 reasoning failure 从“整段链路失败”压缩到“单 token 决策失误”，这给训练动态分析、错误归因、局部监督都提供了更细的观测单位。对于做 pretrain 或 mid-train 的人，这种单位很重要，因为它更接近模型真正做决策的接口。第二层是训练信号层面。作者没有停在解释性分析，而是进一步做了 Cliff-DPO，说明 cliff token 可以作为可操作的偏好学习信号，但不同 cliff 类型的可学性不同：uncertain 和 sampled-off cliffs 能带来收益，deterministic cliffs 基本无效。这一点很关键，它提示并不是所有错误 token 都适合拿来做 post-train 纠偏；有些错误更像能力边界，有些才是采样或局部排序问题。贡献量级上，这不是新的大模型训练范式，但它提供了一种相当干净的 reasoning error microscope，对后续做 token-level credit assignment、过程监督、test-time repair 都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三部分组成。第一部分是 token-wise potential 的定义与估计。给定题目、当前推理前缀和标准答案，在每个 token 位置 t，从该前缀继续 rollout N 次，统计最终命中正确答案的比例，得到 pot_t。文中用 N=64，在整条推理链的每个 token 上都估计，而不是像 Bachmann 等工作那样只抽稀若干点。这样做的代价高，但换来了定位精度。

第二部分是 cliff token 的统计判定。作者不是简单要求 pot_{t-1}-pot_t 超过固定阈值，而是要求它至少超过 0.1，并且通过一侧 two-proportion z-test 的 95% 置信检验。等价地，阈值写成 0.1 + 1.645 * SE_t，其中 SE_t 由相邻两个位置的 rollout 成功率估计方差决定。这样在 pot 接近 0.5、方差较大的区域，判定门槛会更高；在 pot 接近 0 或 1 的区域，门槛较低。作者明确想避免把 rollout 噪声误判成 cliff，这比固定 0.2 或 30% drop 的规则更稳。

第三部分是 cliff taxonomy。作者根据该 token 是否是 greedy choice，以及该位置分布熵的高低，把 cliff 分成 deterministic、uncertain、sampled-off 三类。可以把它理解为三种不同失败机制：deterministic cliff 表示模型高置信地走错；uncertain cliff 表示模型自己也不确定，错误 token 出现在高熵竞争位置；sampled-off cliff 则更像采样偏离，模型的 greedy 也许不会错，但采样选到了坏分支。这个分类不是装饰性的，因为后面的干预和训练结果表明三类 cliff 的可修复性不同。

在干预上，作者做了两种关键验证。其一是删除第一个 cliff token 后重新采样，观察 pass@64 是否恢复；其二是保留 cliff token 但只重采样后续，观察是否仍然无法完全恢复。这个设计直接检验“cliff 是触发点而不是伴随现象”。其后又提出 Cliff-DPO：把 cliff 位置的好坏 token 构造成偏好对，分别在不同 cliff 子集上训练，比较哪类 token 监督真正有用。与一般 process supervision 不同，这里监督信号被压缩到单 token 位置，目标更尖锐。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 7 个模型、3 个 benchmark。模型包括 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-0.6B、Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.2-3B、Llama-3.2-1B、Gemma-3-4B；数据集是 GSM1K、MATH500、AIME 2025。token-wise potential 的 rollout 次数统一设为 64。

最关键的结果有三组。第一组是因果性验证。删除第一个 cliff token 并从该处重采样，作者报告 pass@64 可以恢复到 1.0；相反，如果保留这个 cliff token，只重采样后续，模型无法完全恢复。这说明 cliff token 不是“失败已经发生后的标记”，而是把轨迹推下去的触发点。这个实验是全文最重要的证据。

第二组是 cliff 类型分析。作者发现 deterministic cliffs 在不同模型尺度上更稳定，带有某种 scale-invariant 特征；而 uncertain 与 sampled-off cliffs 更能反映模型间能力差距或尺度不对称。换句话说，小模型和大模型都可能在某些位置高置信犯同一种错，但采样型和不确定型 cliff 更像是“模型还差一点”或“解码把本来能做对的题做坏了”。这对理解 scaling 很有意思：并不是所有错误都会随着规模自然消失。

第三组是 Cliff-DPO。作者把不同类型 cliff 拆开训练，发现 uncertain 和 sampled-off 子集能提升 reasoning 表现，而 deterministic 子集基本没有帮助。虽然给出的全文片段里没有完整训练超参和所有数值表，但结论已经很清楚：如果错误来自高置信错误表征，仅靠局部偏好学习不容易修；如果错误来自排序边界模糊或采样偏离，单 token 监督更有效。这个结果对做 RL/SFT 数据构造的人很有参考价值，因为它告诉你该优先挖哪类失败样本。

另外，文中还说明自适应阈值在不同 pot 区域大约从 0.18 到 0.24 变化，中间概率区域更严格。这是一个小但重要的实现细节，解释了为什么方法不会在高方差位置泛滥地产生假 cliff。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看定义和验证，再看 taxonomy，最后看 Cliff-DPO。具体顺序可以是：
1. 先读 Introduction 和 cliff token 的 formalization，抓住 token-wise potential、N=64 rollout、以及 z-test 自适应阈值这三个支点。
2. 重点看展示单个样例的图，尤其是 token-wise potential 随位置骤降的可视化。这里最容易建立直觉：某个 token 之前轨迹仍可救，之后基本塌掉。
3. 精读 3.2 的干预实验。删除第一个 cliff token 后恢复、保留 cliff 后无法恢复，这部分决定了方法有没有因果解释力。
4. 再看 3.3 和 3.4 的 taxonomy 与跨模型分析。这里值得深挖的是 deterministic/uncertain/sampled-off 的边界定义，以及它们和 entropy、greedy choice 的关系。
5. 最后看 Section 4 的 Cliff-DPO。重点不是训练细节本身，而是为什么 deterministic cliffs 学不动，而另外两类能学动。这一节和 token-level credit assignment、过程监督、test-time decoding 改进都能连起来。

如果时间有限，至少看定义公式、第一组因果实验图表、以及 Cliff-DPO 的分类型结果，30 到 40 分钟能抓住主线。若要深入，建议自己思考两个问题：一是 rollout-based potential 的估计偏差会不会受解码策略影响；二是 cliff token 能否迁移到非数学推理、代码推理或多模态 chain-of-thought。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a very specific failure-analysis question: within a generated reasoning trace, which exact token causes the trajectory to shift from still-recoverable to likely-failing. Prior work usually operates at step, chunk, or sentence granularity, or marks positions after failure has already materialized. That misses the actual trigger. The authors define a cliff token as the token where token-wise potential—the probability of eventually reaching the correct answer given the current prefix—drops significantly. The technical challenge is to identify such triggers reliably under noisy rollout estimates, rather than mistaking sampling variance for a real collapse in reasoning quality.
summary_en.importance: Its value is less about introducing a new training paradigm and more about providing a sharper unit of analysis for reasoning failures. For pretraining and mid-training research, this matters because the model’s actual decisions happen at the token level, while most current diagnostics are much coarser. The paper also goes one step further and shows that cliff tokens can be turned into actionable supervision via Cliff-DPO. The key nuance is that not all failure tokens are equally learnable: uncertain and sampled-off cliffs respond to token-level preference training, while deterministic cliffs largely do not. That distinction is useful for anyone thinking about process supervision, token-level credit assignment, or how post-training signals should be constructed from failed traces.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. First, it defines token-wise potential. For a prompt, a partial reasoning prefix, and a ground-truth answer, the model rolls out N continuations from every token position and measures the fraction that end with the correct answer. This gives pot_t at each token t. The paper uses N=64 and computes this densely over the full trace, not just at a sparse subset of positions. The cost is high, but the localization is precise.

Second, it introduces a statistical criterion for cliff detection. A token is not labeled a cliff simply because pot_{t-1} - pot_t exceeds a fixed threshold. Instead, the drop must be at least 0.1 and pass a one-sided two-proportion z-test at 95% confidence. This yields an adaptive threshold of the form 0.1 + 1.645 * SE_t, where SE_t depends on the estimated variance of the rollout success rates at adjacent positions. The point is to avoid false positives in high-variance regions, especially around intermediate potential values.

Third, the paper proposes a taxonomy of cliff tokens: deterministic, uncertain, and sampled-off. The categorization uses whether the token is the greedy choice and the entropy of the local token distribution. Intuitively, deterministic cliffs correspond to confident but wrong decisions; uncertain cliffs arise at ambiguous, high-entropy positions; sampled-off cliffs reflect failures introduced by sampling away from a better-ranked continuation. This taxonomy is not cosmetic. It becomes central in the intervention and training results.

The causal validation is well designed. The authors delete the first cliff token and resample from that point, then compare this with keeping the cliff token fixed and only resampling the suffix. If recovery happens only when the cliff token is removed, that supports the claim that the token is a trigger rather than a post hoc marker. They then build Cliff-DPO by constructing preference pairs around cliff positions and training on different cliff subsets separately. Compared with generic process supervision, this is a much sharper token-level supervision signal.
summary_en.experiments:
The study covers seven models and three math reasoning benchmarks: Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-0.6B, Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.2-3B, Llama-3.2-1B, and Gemma-3-4B, evaluated on GSM1K, MATH500, and AIME 2025. Token-wise potential is estimated with 64 rollouts per position.

The most important result is the causal intervention. Deleting the first cliff token and resampling restores pass@64 to 1.0, while keeping that token and only resampling the continuation fails to fully recover. That is the strongest evidence in the paper: cliff tokens behave like actual failure triggers, not merely locations where failure becomes visible.

A second result is the cross-model taxonomy analysis. Deterministic cliffs appear relatively scale-invariant, whereas uncertain and sampled-off cliffs better reflect model-specific gaps or scale asymmetries. In practical terms, some errors persist even as models scale because they are confident misgeneralizations, while others are more about uncertainty or decoding-induced branch selection.

A third result comes from Cliff-DPO. Training on uncertain and sampled-off cliff subsets improves reasoning performance, while training on deterministic cliffs does not. The full excerpt does not include every hyperparameter or table entry, but the qualitative conclusion is already informative: token-level supervision helps when the failure is near a ranking boundary or caused by sampling, and helps much less when the model is confidently wrong.

The paper also reports that the adaptive threshold varies roughly from 0.18 to 0.24 depending on the local potential regime, with stricter thresholds in higher-variance middle regions. This is a small but important implementation detail because it explains why the method is more robust than fixed-drop heuristics.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the following order: definition, causal validation, taxonomy, then Cliff-DPO.
1. Start with the formalization section. Focus on token-wise potential, dense rollout estimation with N=64, and the adaptive z-test threshold.
2. Look closely at the example figures showing potential collapse along a trace. They build the right intuition quickly.
3. Spend most of the time on the intervention experiment in Section 3.2. The delete-and-resample versus keep-and-resample comparison is the core of the paper.
4. Then read the taxonomy sections, especially how deterministic, uncertain, and sampled-off cliffs are defined using greedy choice and entropy.
5. Finish with Cliff-DPO. The most interesting question is not the training recipe itself, but why deterministic cliffs are resistant to this kind of supervision while the other two categories are not.

If time is limited, the formal definition, the main causal experiment, and the per-category Cliff-DPO results are enough to capture the paper’s contribution in about 30–40 minutes. For deeper reading, it is worth thinking about two extensions: how sensitive token-wise potential is to the rollout decoding policy, and whether the same framework transfers beyond math reasoning to code or multimodal reasoning traces.

recommendation.zh: 单个token即可触发数学推理失败的发现颠覆传统认知，做LLM预训练数据/训练目标/解码策略的研究员应立刻复现核心实验并纳入内部 ablation。
recommendation.en: The finding that a single token triggers math reasoning failures subverts prior beliefs; LLM pretraining data/objective/decoding researchers should immediately replicate core experiments and include them in internal ablations.

paper.title: Failure Modes of Large Language Models on Research-Level Mathematics: A Taxonomy and an Empirical Characterisation

This paper asks why. Working from the per-question post-mortems in First Proof's Appendix A, I identify four failure modes: citation fabrication (F1), premise smuggling (F2), silent problem reformulation (F3), and local-to-global compatibility gaps (F4).
